papers.abstract: World models help agents assess the consequences of their actions before acting. Many real systems, however, involve multiple actors who make their own decisions, can evolve even when the agent takes no action, and are only partially observed through event logs. We formalize these systems as event worlds and ask whether large language models can predict future observations from the log and the agent's proposed actions. We build complementary benchmarks from human Diplomacy games and real Polymarket trades. Our hierarchical framework compares prediction with and without other actors' actions, then tests multi-step rollouts, predictions for actions never taken, and usefulness to agents. Fine-tuning and more data improve prediction when all actors' recorded actions are given. With only the agent's action, models struggle when other actors strongly affect the outcome, and larger models and longer histories help little. This gap also limits multi-step prediction and agent decisions, with models overestimating plan success. Yet imagined experience and initialization from world models can still improve policy learning. Anticipating other actors' actions remains a central challenge for event world modeling.

analysis.key_results: 当给出所有智能体记录的动作时，微调和更多数据可提高预测；仅给出单个智能体的动作时，模型在受其他智能体强烈影响的情况下表现挣扎，更大模型和更长历史帮助有限；该差距也限制多步预测和智能体决策，模型高估计划成功；但想象经验和世界模型初始化仍可改善策略学习。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未明确说明主要局限，但指出预测其他智能体的动作仍是核心挑战。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出事件世界的概念和评估框架，并构建来自外交游戏和真实预测市场的人类数据集，分析LLM作为事件世界模型的预测能力。
analysis.method: 构建分层基准，比较有无其他智能体动作时的预测，测试多步推演、未采取动作的预测，并评估对智能体决策的帮助；采用微调和大模型等方法改善预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文将多智能体、自然演化的系统形式化为事件世界，并评估大语言模型从事件日志预测未来观测的能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文讨论世界模型在动态、多智能体环境中的扩展，对本站的World Model主题有间接参考价值，但不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或机器人世界模型，且数据集为文本事件日志，没有直接关联机器人学习。

papers.abstract: Weight-only quantization keeps LLM activations in floating point and stores weights as low-bit integers, turning the dominant workload into floating-point-integer (FP-INT) general matrix multiplication. Recent quantizers reach a 2-3-bit average with mixed precision, but hardware has not kept pace: GPUs dequantize weights to FP16 before the tensor-core multiply-accumulate, and bit-parallel FP-INT accelerators run at a single weight precision, so fewer bits save memory but not computation. In this paper, we present FIGFLEX, an algorithm-hardware co-designed mixed-precision accelerator whose bit-parallel datapath scales throughput as precision falls. FIGFLEX contributes (1) a shift-add, radix-4 reformulation of FP-INT multiplication that fuses the multiply-accumulate into a unified, precision-flexible partial-product reduction and roughly halves the partial products, together with a novel INT3 optimization that reclaims the idle datapath radix-4 leaves at that precision; and (2) a mixed-precision quantizer that assigns each channel group its bit-width according to the error GPTQ cannot compensate, with a per-input-channel column scaling whose power-of-two normalization keeps the scaled activations out of the FP16 subnormal range, so that the quantized model maps directly onto FIGFLEX's datapath with the same accuracy as on a GPU. On LLaMA-2-7B, FIGFLEX attains 5.85 and 8.77 WikiText-2 perplexity at 3- and 2-bit average precision, lower than GPTQ, AWQ, SliM-LLM, AMQ, and QuIP# (without fine-tuning), while delivering 1.56x and 1.42x higher whole-chip throughput per area on the linear GEMMs of a 3-bit mixed-precision model than AxCore and FIGLUT, respectively.

analysis.key_results: 在LLaMA-2-7B上，3位和2位平均精度分别达到5.85和8.77的WikiText-2困惑度，优于GPTQ、AWQ、SliM-LLM、AMQ和QuIP#（无微调）；在3位混合精度模型的线性GEMM上，整芯片吞吐量/面积比AxCore高1.56倍，比FIGLUT高1.42倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FIGFLEX，一个算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度加速器，包括一种移位加基4重构的FP-INT乘法（融合乘累加并减少部分积），以及一种按通道组分配位宽的混合精度量化器，使量化模型可直接映射到加速器且精度与GPU一致。
analysis.method: 采用移位加基4的FP-INT乘法重构，融合乘累加为统一的部分积归约；使用INT3优化；提出基于GPTQ无法补偿误差的通道组位宽分配和功率归一化列缩放的混合精度量化器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FIGFLEX是算法-硬件协同设计的混合精度加速器，通过可扩展吞吐量的位并行数据通路和混合精度量化器提升低比特LLM推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM的权重量化和FP-INT GEMM加速器设计，未涉及VLA或WAM。其量化方法和硬件加速思路可作为VLA/WAM等机器人模型部署时的效率优化参考。

papers.abstract: Should an embodied agent's experience be baked into its policy weights, or kept external and retrieved at inference? A memory-augmented teacher (a VLM that retrieves lessons, with their episode images, from its own past attempts) produces trajectories on a vision-conditioned reach task; from the same trajectories we distil LoRA student policies and evaluate them under matched protocols, including one that re-attaches the teacher's frozen retrieval buffer to a fixed set of student weights. We pre-registered the hypotheses, arms, tests, and analysis rules before training and before any p-value. Distilling the memory-augmented behaviour into weights beat an action-only control by +1 pp (n.s.); the registered test proves underpowered for its own minimum effect, so we withdraw - rather than refute - the memory-in-weights claim. Attaching retrieval to a fixed set of student weights added +34 pp (z=5.15), reaching the pooled memory-augmented teacher reference (49.3%); the pre-registered protocol contrast agrees (+23 pp, z=3.36); under a pre-registered auto-reset sensitivity count the two are +36 and +29 pp. An exploratory behavioural probe with pre-registered per-arm predictions is consistent with behavioural distillation transferring the marginal correction but not the conditional, situation-specific correction that retrieval supplies. The recipe that follows is to externalise the memory: in follow-up controls registered before they ran, the same frozen buffer lifts the base model with no adapter to 48% (sensitivity 48%) and the other three adapters from 19-26% to 53-55% (sensitivity 17-21% to 50-55%), and the adapter adds nothing detectable once the buffer is attached. On a second, harder task, the retrieval advantage points the same direction but falls short of significance (+6 pp, 95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]); exploratory diagnostics tie the attenuation to memory coverage.

analysis.key_results: 蒸馏记忆增强行为比仅动作控制提高1个百分点（不显著）；附加检索记忆使固定学生权重性能提高34个百分点（z=5.15），达到教师参考水平49.3%；在更难任务上检索优势方向一致但未达显著性（+6 pp，95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]）。
analysis.limitations: 注册测试在检测其最小效应方面功效不足；在更难任务上检索优势未达统计显著性。
analysis.main_contribution: 通过预注册研究证明，将记忆外部化（即检索式记忆）相比将经验蒸馏进策略权重，能更有效地提升具身智能体的任务表现。
analysis.method: 使用记忆增强的教师模型（VLM）生成轨迹并蒸馏LoRA学生策略，在视觉条件下的到达任务上对比权重内记忆与外部检索记忆的效果。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过预注册实验研究了将具身智能体的经验存储在策略权重中与外部检索记忆中的效果差异，发现外部检索记忆对性能提升更为显著。

papers.abstract: Tactile sensing provides robots with direct access to physical interactions at the contact interface, making it a critical modality for robust and dexterous manipulation. Over the past several decades, tactile-based manipulation research has evolved from mechanics-driven approaches, which explicitly interpret tactile signals through contact mechanics and task-specific reasoning, to data-driven approaches that learn tactile representations and manipulation policies directly from data. This paper reviews the development of tactile-based manipulation from these two complementary perspectives. We first introduce the fundamentals of tactile sensing, and then review, from a mechanics-driven perspective, how those signals form manipulation-relevant state representations and subsequently influence the robot action. We then examine the recent advances in data-driven tactile manipulation, covering imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, and predictive models. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future opportunities toward scalable, generalizable, and robust tactile-enabled robotic systems.

papers.abstract: In recent years, Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) have gained massive attention as an energy-efficient neural computing paradigm due to their event-driven and sparse computing capability. However, maintaining accuracy under low-precision constraints, necessary for practical deployment, has been largely unexplored for SNN models. In addition, existing Hessian-based approaches for quantization, such as HAWQ-V2, incur significant memory and computational overhead due to temporal unrolling across multiple SNN timesteps. We propose a spike-aware gradient-based mixed-precision quantization framework for SNNs that adaptively assigns bit-widths using first-order gradient information, avoiding costly second-order Hessian computations. We evaluate our method across various SNN-based architectures, including VGG, ResNet, and Vision Transformer models obtained from both ANN-to-SNN conversion and direct training frameworks, on CIFAR10/100, ImageNet, and DVS-CIFAR-10 datasets. Notably, on ResNet-34 evaluated on ImageNet, our method achieves 73.30% accuracy at 4.78$\times$ compression, which is comparable to that provided by HAWQ-V2, while reducing memory consumption by 2.31$\times$ and bit-allocation runtime by 100$\times$. We also present an energy analysis for mixed-precision SNNs showing that the proposed quantization strategy enables energy-efficient deployment without compromising performance.

analysis.key_results: 在ImageNet上的ResNet-34模型达到73.30%准确率，压缩率4.78倍；与HAWQ-V2相比，内存消耗降低2.31倍，位分配运行时间降低100倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种脉冲感知的梯度混合精度量化框架，利用一阶梯度信息自适应分配位宽，避免二阶Hessian计算，显著减少内存和运行时间。
analysis.method: 使用一阶梯度的混合精度量化方法，自适应分配位宽，无需二阶Hessian计算和时序展开。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一种基于一阶梯度的脉冲感知混合精度量化框架，用于降低脉冲神经网络的量化开销并实现高效部署。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising approach to learning generalist robot policies using rich spatiotemporal priors from pre-trained video diffusion models. A recent line of WAMs improves inference efficiency by conditioning a separate action decoder on intermediate future video representations extracted from a single denoising step, avoiding costly iterative denoising required for video generation. This design makes action prediction depend directly on the quality of these future representations. In this paper, we introduce Future REpresentation learning via self-Distillation with temporal context (FRED), a framework that trains WAMs to improve the quality of future video representations from noise in a single denoising step. Specifically, FRED uses self-distillation to predict future representations from noise, using representations extracted from ground-truth future observations as targets. We further condition the video model on historical observations, providing temporal context for predicting future representations better. Across diverse real-world manipulation scenarios, FRED consistently outperforms competing WAMs. It achieves particularly large gains on long-horizon and out-of-domain tasks under zero-shot environment generalization, and substantially improves human-to-robot skill transfer, reaching 50.0% task success on tasks absent from robot training data and demonstrated only in human videos, compared with 19.4% for the best competing WAM.

analysis.key_results: 在多种真实世界操作场景中，FRED持续优于竞争WAM，在长时程和分布外任务上取得显著提升，并在零样本环境泛化下将人类到机器人技能迁移成功率从最佳竞争WAM的19.4%提升至50.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入FRED（通过带时序上下文的自蒸馏进行未来表征学习）框架，训练WAM在单个去噪步骤中从噪声预测高质量的未来视频表征，使用真实未来观测提取的表征作为蒸馏目标，并利用历史观测提供时序上下文。
analysis.method: 自蒸馏，使用从真实未来观测中提取的表征作为目标，从噪声预测未来表征；同时将视频模型以历史观测为条件，提供时序上下文。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出FRED框架，利用自蒸馏和历史观测条件，在单步去噪中提升未来视频表征质量，从而改进世界动作模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本工作直接聚焦于世界动作模型（WAM），通过改进未来视频表征的单步预测质量来提升WAM的推理效率和策略性能，与本站WAM主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Recent world action models provide visual foresight and future prediction for robot manipulation, but lack explicit mechanisms for compositional skill reuse. Agentic robotics combines code-based planning and reasoning with reusable skills, but often lacks predictive grounding in physical dynamics. We introduce AW-0, an agentic world action model framework that integrates code-based planning with joint video and action prediction. We jointly model code, future video, and robot actions as three coupled generative streams within a unified mixture-of-transformers architecture. Within this architecture a code expert generates parameterized skill routines and control logic while video and action experts generate future visual states and low-level motor commands. Code serves two complementary roles: it structures multi-step prediction and control within the world model and represents skills as reusable programs for subsequent agentic execution. We further introduce an automated curation pipeline that labels robot and human video trajectories with aligned programs and consolidates recurring routines into reusable skill libraries. Evaluations on RoboTwin 2.0 and physical bimanual manipulation tasks show improved task performance over VLA and WAM baselines, alongside gains in language following, semantic reasoning and robustness, demonstrating that agentic code enables connection between planning, prediction and execution within WAMs.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboTwin 2.0和实物双臂操作任务上，相比VLA和WAM基线取得改进，并提升了语言遵循、语义推理和鲁棒性。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入AW-0，一个智能体世界动作模型框架，集成代码规划与视频和动作预测，并通过自动化管线构建可重用技能库。
analysis.method: 联合建模代码、未来视频和机器人动作三个生成流，采用统一混合Transformer架构，代码专家生成参数化技能程序，视频和动作专家生成未来视觉状态和低级控制指令。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AW-0框架，将代码规划与视频和动作预测统一为混合Transformer世界动作模型，支持组合式技能重用。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对世界动作模型（WAM），将代码规划与视觉和动作预测结合，体现了本站对WAM和VLA研究的核心关注，对机器人操作和策略学习具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfers to external mathematics and perception benchmarks. Because the minimal-edit teacher evaluates corrections rather than generating its own solution, the method remains effective with a frozen same-size teacher, although its gains are smaller than with a larger teacher on most metrics.

analysis.key_results: 在多个模型规模上，该方法无需测试时描述即可达到或超过相应基础模型在推理时提供参考图描述的性能；提升感知导向性能，特别是低层次几何感知，并能迁移到外部数学与感知基准。
analysis.limitations: 使用相同规模的冻结教师时仍有效，但在多数指标上增益小于较大教师。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation，仅使用训练时的参考图描述与验证参考解，通过最小编辑目标对错误轨迹进行校正，并对正确轨迹施加任务奖励强化学习，从而避免测试时额外标注或模型调用。
analysis.method: 利用参考图描述和验证参考解作为训练独占信息，教师对错误学生轨迹进行评分，仅教师不赞成的 token 参与校正损失；正确轨迹获得任务奖励强化学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种最小编辑校正的在策略蒸馏方法，在无需推理时参考描述的情况下提升视觉语言模型的数学推理能力，尤其是低层次几何感知。

papers.abstract: Video world models predict future frames from past frames and actions. They serve as simulators in which agents train, plan or are evaluated, and that humans can control interactively. They generate in the latent space of a video autoencoder, whose compression sets their cost per frame and how long each action waits to take effect. Yet world models often reuse the autoencoders of text-to-video generators, built for offline generation with no agent waiting and, without their training data and code, not retrainable at another compression. We therefore ask how, where and how much a world model should compress. We build CADRE, an open family of causal diffusion representation autoencoders spanning multiple spatio-temporal compressions. Its members differ only in a small bottleneck on frozen features and share a diffusion decoder self-distilled to one or a few steps. We train the same world model on each autoencoder in two domains, manipulation and navigation, with two environments each. CADRE forms most of the latency-quality frontier, especially with a moving camera. Our study also leads to four findings. At strong compression, a diffusion decoder is sharper than perceptual regression. In robot manipulation, temporal compression is more effective in the autoencoder than in the world model. Manipulation and navigation call for opposite compressions: temporal compression costs little when the camera is still, and spatial compression when it moves. Surprisingly, with a still camera, coarser spatial tokens hurt motion far more than image quality. Code, models and a live demo are at https://kyutai.org/blog/2026-10-21-cadre

analysis.key_results: 在强压缩下，扩散解码器比感知回归更清晰；在机器人操控中，时间压缩在自编码器中比在世界模型中更有效；操控和导航需要相反的压缩方式：相机静止时时间压缩代价小，相机移动时空间压缩代价小；相机静止时，更粗的空间token对运动的伤害远大于对图像质量的伤害。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CADRE，一个开源的因果扩散表示自编码器家族，支持多种时空压缩率，并系统研究了视频世界模型中压缩对交互式任务性能的影响。
analysis.method: 构建CADRE家族，其成员仅在冻结特征上的小瓶颈不同，共享一个自蒸馏到一步或几步的扩散解码器；在同一世界模型中，在操控和导航两个领域、各两个环境中训练和评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文通过构建CADRE（一种因果扩散表示自编码器家族），研究视频世界模型中压缩对交互式任务（尤其是机器人操控和导航）的影响。

papers.abstract: World models turn visual representations into predictions and actions. We argue that their visual foundation should combine physical-state information, native language alignment, and pixel reconstruction, so that a single representation can support prediction, instruction, and inspection. However, existing encoders typically specialize in only one or two of these capabilities; we therefore introduce ALPS, a pretrained visual state encoder that unifies all three in a single set of patch tokens. Using only still images and text, we pretrain a ViT-B/16 from scratch with language, reconstruction, and spatial correspondence objectives, and then refine it via cross-view self-distillation. In a unified evaluation across fifteen public encoders, ALPS achieves the lowest aggregate LIBERO state-probe error among ViT-B models (matching the 3.5x larger V-JEPA 2-L) while maintaining strong language alignment and accurate pixel reconstruction. Downstream, frozen ALPS tokens reach the highest mean policy success on LIBERO (85.5%) when paired with our native text tower, match or exceed leading encoders on world-model planning across PushT, Wall, and Granular, and allow predicted future tokens to be decoded directly into pixels for visual inspection. We hope this work helps establish visual pretraining as a shared foundation for understanding, prediction, and action in world models.

analysis.key_results: ALPS在ViT-B模型中取得LIBERO状态探针误差最低（与3.5倍大的V-JEPA 2-L相当），保持强语言对齐和准确像素重建；在LIBERO上平均策略成功率最高（85.5%），在世界模型规划上与领先编码器相当或更好。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入ALPS，一个预训练的视觉状态编码器，将物理状态信息、原生语言对齐和像素重建统一到单个patch token集合中，并使用仅静态图像和文本进行预训练。
analysis.method: 使用ViT-B/16从零开始预训练，结合语言、重建和空间对应目标，并通过跨视角自蒸馏进行细化；在LIBERO、PushT、Wall和Granular等基准上评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ALPS视觉状态编码器，统一物理状态信息、语言对齐和像素重建，为世界模型提供单一视觉基础表示。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接为世界模型构建视觉基础表示，统一状态预测、语言指令和像素重建，显著支持VLA/WAM研究。其世界模型规划、策略学习和平移与机器人操作评估，直接贡献于动作预测和机器人学习。

figures.caption: Two-stage visual state pretraining. Stage 1 trains an encoder E E from scratch with four objectives on shared patch tokens. Stage 2 initializes a student from E E and keeps E E frozen as the teacher. Given student tokens from an augmented crop A A and query tokens encoding position and relative scale, a predictor regresses standardized teacher tokens from a clean crop B B . Only patches of B B whose centers lie inside A A contribute to the loss. After training, the predictor is discarded and the refined student serves as ALPS.

papers.abstract: Force-sensitive manipulation requires contact and load information that is not provided explicitly by visual observations. We present CW-WAM, a world action model that jointly predicts video, motion, and contact wrench. Inspired by hybrid motion-force control, it contains a unified interaction module that treats both motion and contact wrench as modeling targets and predicts time-aligned motion-wrench chunks as control references. A pair-causal attention mechanism structures the motion-wrench dependencies, while a long fixed-length wrench memory retains past interaction information. The predicted wrench chunk acts as a force reference for a 20-Hz outer-loop admittance controller within a slow-fast control system that maintains force feedback and smooth motion between model queries. CW-WAM improves contact prediction and increases the insertion success rate from 25% to 70% for square pegs with 1-mm clearance per side and from 40% to 95% for power adapters, compared with WAM without wrench input. It also improves lifting-height accuracy across different loads. Our framework with an admittance controller reduces force-reference RMSE from 4.8 to 2.7 N for peg insertion and from 2.0 to 1.3 N for wiping, respectively, with smaller force fluctuations during successful execution. Project website: https://cw-wam-project.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 将1mm间隙方销插入成功率从25%提升至70%，电源适配器插入成功率从40%提升至95%；力参考RMSE从4.8N降至2.7N（销插入）和从2.0N降至1.3N（擦拭）；提升不同负载下的举升高度精度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CW-WAM，通过联合预测视频、运动和接触力，统一建模运动和接触力的交互模块，以及成对因果注意力和固定长度力记忆，提升力敏感操作。
analysis.method: CW-WAM 世界行动模型结合统一交互模块、成对因果注意力机制和长固定长度力记忆，预测时间对齐的运动-力块；并与20Hz外环导纳控制器集成，实现慢快控制系统。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CW-WAM，一种联合预测视频、运动和接触力的世界行动模型，用于提升力敏感操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是WAM（世界行动模型）的改进，直接面向机器人操作，并引入力觉与导纳控制，对VLA/WAM主题具有高度相关性。

papers.abstract: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.

analysis.key_results: 在64个基准中，显式评估集中在“行动”能力，只有5个评估“预期”，3个评估“验证”，两者大多隐藏在任务成功指标背后。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PAPAV，一个以能力为中心的统一框架，用于描述、比较和分析多模态智能体、机器人系统与多模态具身智能体，并识别开放挑战。
analysis.method: 通过定义感知、预期、规划、行动、验证五个功能能力，并以功能而非架构为基础，对三类系统进行横向比较，结合64个基准分析评估现状。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出PAPAV框架，以五个能力维度统一比较计算机使用智能体、机器人系统与多模态具身智能体，并分析物理约束与评估缺口。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向多模态机器人智能体（VLA）的能力刻画与评估，提出的PAPAV框架与物理约束分析对VLA/WAM的设计与评测具有方法学价值。

Defined by function rather than architecture, they place both settings on a common coordinate and isolate what changes once actions acquire physical consequences.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown promise in robotic manipulation, but imitation learning (IL) alone often struggles to master complex long-horizon skills. Reinforcement learning (RL) offers an effective avenue for further improving VLA policies. However, existing VLA-RL methods typically suffer from delayed and biased credit assignment due to trajectory-level sparse rewards, while imbalanced subtask mastery creates bottlenecks that limit overall performance. To address these challenges, we propose AtomicRL, an RL post-training framework that leverages atomic task structures for reliable credit assignment and adaptive exploration. AtomicRL introduces Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses semantic-aware gating to constrain TD residuals from failed atomic subtasks from propagating across task boundaries, mitigating credit contamination while preserving intra-subtask credit assignment and value bootstrapping. In addition, Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration (BATE) dynamically coordinates task sampling and local exploration incentives based on the mastery of individual atomic subtasks, directing learning toward the remaining bottlenecks. Finally, we develop a Real2Sim2Real pipeline that bridges online RL in simulation with real-world deployment, facilitating practical transfer to physical robots. On LIBERO-LONG, AtomicRL achieves absolute performance gains of 3.6% and 4.0% over PPO across two VLA architectures. On CALVIN ABC-D, it improves full-task performance by up to 9.5% over PPO. Combined with the Real2Sim2Real pipeline, AtomicRL further improves real-world task performance by an average of 21.3%. These results demonstrate that AtomicRL effectively improves the learning efficiency and manipulation performance of VLA policies on long-horizon tasks.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-LONG上，AtomicRL在两种VLA架构上比PPO绝对性能提升3.6%和4.0%；在CALVIN ABC-D上，完整任务性能最高比PPO提升9.5%；结合Real2Sim2Real后，真实世界任务性能平均提升21.3%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出AtomicRL强化学习后训练框架，包含Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization（SAPO）和Bottleneck-Adaptive Target Exploration（BATE）两个组件，以及Real2Sim2Real管线。
analysis.method: SAPO通过语义感知门控约束跨任务边界失败原子子任务的TD残差传播；BATE根据原子子任务掌握程度动态协调任务采样和局部探索激励；Real2Sim2Real管线桥接仿真RL与真实部署。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AtomicRL框架，利用原子任务结构改进VLA策略的强化学习后训练，实现长时序操作任务中的可靠信用分配与自适应探索。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对VLA模型的策略学习，通过原子任务结构改进长时序机器人操作的强化学习后训练，属于VLA策略学习和机器人操作的核心研究，与VLA主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Overall pipeline of AtomicRL. (a) Progress–Completion Critic: PCC identifies atomic task boundaries and estimates atomic task progress from interaction histories. (b) Semantic-Aware Policy Optimization: SAPO uses these signals to regulate cross-subtask advantage propagation based on subtask execution outcomes. (c) Bottleneck-Adaptive Targeted Exploration: BATE adapts task sampling and local exploration according to subtask mastery, focusing training on insufficiently mastered bottleneck subtasks. (d) Real2Sim2Real workflow: A complementary Real2Sim2Real pipeline enables parallel simulation-based training and transfer to real-world robots.

papers.abstract: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires an effective interface between high-level task policies and whole-body control. Existing interfaces typically rely on a single action representation for both task intent and whole-body coordination. This may burden the high-level policy or leave one aspect underspecified. We present SP-HLM, a framework built on a sparse-pose-driven interface. The interface combines five task-critical body poses with a learned latent motion prior to represent spatial intent and whole-body coordination in complementary forms. SP-VLA, a vision-language-action model, first predicts task-relevant sparse poses and finger joint positions from multimodal observations and language instructions using asynchronous action-chunk inference. Given these sparse targets, SP-MGM, a motion generation model trained through two-stage distillation, reconstructs coordinated full-body motion in real time. A pretrained motion encoder maps this motion to a compact latent representation. SP-GMT, a general motion tracker, then integrates the explicit sparse targets with this implicit motion prior for whole-body control. Experiments in simulation and on a real humanoid robot demonstrate improved motion tracking, whole-body coordination, and loco-manipulation success over existing approaches. Additional results and videos are available on our \href{https://sp-hlm.github.io/}{\textcolor{blue}{project page}}.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真和真实人形机器人上，相比现有方法提升了运动跟踪、全身协调和移动操作成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SP-HLM 框架，通过稀疏姿态驱动接口整合高层任务策略与全身控制，包括 SP-VLA、SP-MGM 和 SP-GMT 三个模块。
analysis.method: SP-VLA 预测稀疏姿势和手指关节位置；SP-MGM 通过两阶段蒸馏重建全身运动；SP-GMT 融合显式稀疏目标和隐式运动先验进行全身控制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SP-HLM 提出一种稀疏姿态驱动的人形机器人移动操作框架，结合高层 VLA 策略与运动生成/控制模块，提升全身协调与任务成功率。

papers.abstract: Robots must act under physical and social constraints while adapting to changes in their environment and human needs. Existing embodied-agent systems often focus on specified goals or abstract execution into symbolic actions, limiting evaluation in an evolving world. We introduce TARSphere, a robot-oriented full-stack framework for physically and socially grounded long-horizon embodied agents. TARSphere-Infra runs robot policies in a physics simulator with embodied NPCs and constrained dialogue. An event-driven finite-state machine (FSM) uses completed actions and delivered information to update task states and evaluate outcomes. TARSphere-Harness, its embodied brain harness, lets a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM) act through multi-level executable skills, using observations, hierarchical memory, and execution feedback to revise its decisions. On this foundation, agent-in-the-loop curation aligns task semantics, causal dependencies, and scene geometry to construct TARSphere-Bench: 360 episodes across 30 indoor scenes. Five paired conditions assess perceptual robustness, disruption adaptation, task update, human coordination, and intent understanding for navigate-and-report and fetch-and-deliver tasks. Our evaluation of 8 MLLMs shows that general-purpose models can outperform embodied models, while task updates and human interaction remain difficult. Frequent collisions and falls further motivate evaluating execution safety alongside task success, even with a shared action interface and decision budget.

analysis.key_results: TARSphere-Bench 包含 360 个片段、30 个室内场景，5 种成对条件；8 个 MLLM 的评估显示通用模型可优于具身模型，但任务更新和人机交互仍然困难；频繁碰撞和跌倒表明需同时评估执行安全与任务成功。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了 TARSphere-Infra 基础设施、TARSphere-Harness 具身大脑接口和 TARSphere-Bench 基准，支持长期具身智能体在物理与社会进化环境中的评估。
analysis.method: 利用物理模拟器、具身 NPC 和受约束对话构建环境；通过事件驱动的有限状态机更新任务状态；使用多级可执行技能让冻结的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）基于观察、层次记忆和执行反馈进行决策；采用智能体在环策展生成基准。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个机器人导向的全栈框架 TARSphere，在物理与社会动态环境中评估长期具身智能体并构建基准。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）及机器人世界模型相关方向：通过多模态大语言模型作为具身大脑进行长期任务决策，并在物理与社会动态环境中评估，对 VLA 的评测与改进具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Language 3D Gaussian Splatting enables open-vocabulary scene understanding by associating Gaussian primitives with language features. These semantic attributes increase model storage, while most existing 3DGS compression methods are designed mainly to preserve RGB rendering quality. One straightforward approach is to apply sparsification and quantization sequentially. However, pruning based only on rendering quality can remove Gaussians that have small RGB contributions but are important for semantic prediction. Once removed, their semantic information cannot be recovered by later quantization. We propose ClunoGS, a compact framework for Language 3DGS that combines semantics-aware Gaussian sparsification and vector quantization in a unified constrained objective. Semantic supervision is used during sparsification, and the objective jointly considers rendering quality, semantic accuracy, and compactness. We optimize the unified objective with alternating primal, sparsification, quantization, and dual updates. We evaluate ClunoGS on open-vocabulary localization and segmentation using the LERF and ScanNet-10 benchmarks. Under aggressive compression, our unified, semantics-aware formulation substantially alleviates the degradation of semantic representations caused by sequential compression and semantics-agnostic Gaussian sparsification. Ablations further show that jointly coordinating sparsification and quantization better preserves semantic accuracy than applying them independently.

analysis.key_results: 在 LERF 和 ScanNet-10 基准上的开放词汇定位与分割任务中，激进压缩下统一语义感知公式显著缓解了顺序压缩和语义无关稀疏化造成的语义表示退化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ClunoGS 框架，在统一约束目标中结合语义感知的高斯稀疏化和向量量化，以在压缩模型的同时保留语义预测精度。
analysis.method: 在稀疏化阶段引入语义监督，并联合优化渲染质量、语义准确性和紧凑度的统一目标，采用交替原始变量、稀疏化、量化和对偶变量更新。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ClunoGS提出一种针对语言3DGS的紧凑表示框架，将语义感知的稀疏化与向量量化统一在一个约束目标中联合优化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作针对语言3DGS的紧凑表示与量化，属于高效推理与视觉语言模型的结合，未直接涉及VLA或机器人世界模型，但其语义压缩技术对具身模型中的场景表示压缩具有潜在参考价值。

figures.caption: Impact of pipeline ordering in semantic 3DGS compression. Semantic-first learns semantics before compression, whereas Compression-first compresses the 3DGS before semantic learning. PCA visualizations show that both sequential pipelines degrade semantic representations, while our unified pipeline better preserves them.

papers.abstract: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上平均成功率达98.9%，在RoboTwin干净/随机设置上分别达91.10%和91.24%，在五个真实世界任务中平均成功率为78.0%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GeoMem-VLA框架，通过几何流匹配目标将3D监督内化为几何令牌，并将其作为时序记忆用于动作生成，无需在推理时调用3D教师或显式重建场景。
analysis.method: 在训练时使用冻结的几何基础模型监督可学习的GeoPlan令牌，通过几何流匹配目标对当前场景点图和未来末端执行器轨迹进行建模；GeoPlan令牌与观察表示记忆集成，历史信息被检索、自适应融合并保留事件帧；推理时仅利用历史表示与当前工作表示预测动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GeoMem-VLA通过几何流匹配将3D场景理解内化为可更新的时序记忆令牌，并用于机器人动作生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型，通过内化3D几何信息并构建时序记忆来提升机器人操作能力，与本站的VLA和世界建模主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Vision-language perception has achieved impressive progress in aligning natural language with visual observations, yet grounding high-level semantics into part-level physical interaction remains challenging. To address this gap, we propose UniRAP, a unified model for inferring part-level physical affordances and mapping language instructions to actionable geometric representations. UniRAP formulates this problem as a conditional multimodal generation task, integrating visual inputs, textual instructions, and optional prompts into a shared spatiotemporal representation space through a unified interface token mechanism. To predict executable contact geometry, we introduce a Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD), which jointly performs object detection, part-level affordance segmentation, and 4-DoF interaction pose estimation by leveraging intermediate segmentation features. In addition, we propose a curriculum-based transfer training strategy that progressively adapts the model from general visual parsing to interaction-aware perception, improving data efficiency under limited textual annotations. Experiments show that UniRAP achieves state-of-the-art performance on referring expression segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction pose estimation, while maintaining strong spatiotemporal consistency in dynamic video scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of UniRAP as a unified perception framework for language-guided physical manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在指代表达分割、可供性 grounding 和交互位姿估计上达到最先进性能，并在动态视频场景中保持时空一致性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 UniRAP，一个统一模型，通过条件多模态生成和统一 affordance 解码器，联合执行物体检测、部件级可供性分割和 4-DoF 交互位姿估计，并采用课程迁移训练策略提高数据效率。
analysis.method: 统一接口 token 机制将视觉、文本和可选提示映射到共享时空表示；Unified Affordance Decoder (UAD) 利用中间分割特征联合输出检测、可供性分割和交互位姿；课程式迁移训练从通用视觉解析逐步适应交互感知。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: UniRAP 提出统一模型，将视觉语言指令映射到部件级物理可供性与可执行几何表示，用于语言引导的物理操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向语言引导的机器人物理操作，输出部件级可供性和可执行交互位姿，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）感知核心问题；虽未显式提及世界模型，但可执行几何表示与动作感知高度相关。

figures.caption: UniRAP transfers large-scale generic segmentation pretraining to affordance segmentation and spatiotemporally actionable perception, improving language grounding for task-relevant regions and dynamics. It enhances referring segmentation, affordance grounding, and interaction modeling while maintaining strong spatio-temporal consistency.

figures.caption: Overview of UniRAP Model. Given visual input 𝐱 v \mathbf{x}_{v} , text prompt 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} , and optional visual reference prompts 𝐱 r \mathbf{x}_{r} , a multimodal model ℱ \mathcal{F} produces <SEG> -conditioned outputs. When <REF> is present, visual prompts are encoded as embeddings and jointly modeled with text within a shared <SEG> representation space. Concurrently, visual features from 𝐱 v \mathbf{x}_{v} are aggregated with memory bank representations via memory attention. The resulting features are aligned with <SEG> -derived embeddings through an MLP projector and decoded by an affordance decoder 𝒟 \mathcal{D} to generate segmentation masks, region detections, and 4-DoF interaction poses for unified vision–language spatiotemporal actionable perception.

papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software engineering artifacts written in domain-specific languages (DSLs). Correct DSL instances usually must comply with not only the concrete syntax but also the abstract syntax defined by a metamodel augmented with semantic well-formedness constraints. Existing constrained decoding approaches typically guarantee compliance only with concrete syntax or with a limited set of semantic constraints expressed over the generated text, making metamodel-level constraint consistency difficult to enforce during generation. We present MeMoDecode: a decoding framework that enforces a DSL's concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and well-formedness constraints jointly. Specifically, whenever the LLM generates a complete metamodel concept, MeMoDecode incrementally maps the current output to a partial model and verifies whether it can still be completed into a consistent instance. We combine MeMoDecode with a simple retry mechanism that resumes decoding from the most recent completable snapshot whenever an inconsistency is detected. Under a sound backend verifier, MeMoDecode never performs worse than grammar-constrained decoding on alignment metrics satisfying natural assumptions. Across four DSLs and six open-weight LLMs ranging from 0.6B to 70B parameters, MeMoDecode achieves the highest consistency, improving consistency by 23% on average over unconstrained decoding and by 8% on average over grammar-constrained decoding. It also improves benchmark performance while incurring only modest runtime overhead. These results show that metamodel-guided decoding is an effective approach for enforcing DSL consistency during decoding across diverse DSLs and LLM scales.

analysis.key_results: 在四个 DSL 和六个 0.6B 至 70B 参数的开源 LLM 上，MeMoDecode 实现最高一致性，相比无约束解码平均提升 23%，相比语法约束解码平均提升 8%，同时改善基准性能且运行时开销适度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 MeMoDecode 框架：在 LLM 生成完整元模型概念时增量构建部分模型，并验证其是否仍能补全为一致实例，通过重试机制恢复一致快照。
analysis.method: 将当前输出映射为部分模型并验证可补全性；发现不一致时回溯至最近可补全快照并重试解码。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 MeMoDecode，一种在解码过程中联合执行领域特定语言具体语法、抽象语法和良构约束的元模型引导解码框架。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于软件工程领域 DSL 生成中的一致性约束解码，不直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人世界模型；其元模型引导与回溯重试的约束解码思想对受限生成有方法论参考价值，但与本站主题无直接交集。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies need to recognize gaps in their training knowledge to request useful demonstrations or assistance in new situations, especially when failures are costly. Disagreement within an ensemble of independently trained policies can guide these decisions, but requires training and running multiple policies. We propose post-hoc kernel-variance heads that estimate epistemic uncertainty from the embeddings of a single policy. Each head computes the conditional variance of a Gaussian process conditioned on embeddings from the training demonstrations. Fitting requires no regression targets or gradient updates and leaves the policy unchanged. In experiments with SmolVLA on LIBERO-10, the kernel variance heads perform competitively with two-policy ensemble scores in task-level correlation with task success, in demonstration acquisition during active learning, and in referral to a stronger supervisor policy as a proxy for human assistance. For SmolVLA, the head on the vision-language backbone reduces uncertainty-scoring time by up to approximately a factor of 50 compared with ensemble scores, while also substantially reducing setup costs. We also show that the established evaluation protocol on LIBERO-10 primarily rewards recognition of coverage differences between tasks, while execution variability weakens assessment of within-task rankings. Thus, controlled perturbations provide a complementary evaluation: modality-specific heads identify unfamiliar camera, instruction, or state inputs, while fused heads can detect unfamiliar combinations of individually familiar inputs. With a supervisor proxy trained on the evaluated perturbation families, the decoder head improves within-task referral over ensemble disagreement. These findings show that useful uncertainty estimates for adaptive robot learning can be obtained from a single policy.

analysis.key_results: 在SmolVLA和LIBERO-10上，核方差头在任务级相关、主动学习演示获取和向更强监督策略转交任务方面与双策略集成分数竞争力相当；视觉-语言骨干上的头将不确定性评分时间减少约50倍；受控扰动评估中模态特定头能识别不熟悉的相机、指令或状态输入，融合头能检测熟悉输入的陌生组合；解码器头在有监督代理的扰动家族上比集成不一致性改进了任务内转交。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出后置核方差头（post-hoc kernel-variance heads），从单个策略的嵌入估计认知不确定性，无需回归目标或梯度更新，且不改变原有策略。
analysis.method: 利用高斯过程条件方差，基于训练演示的嵌入计算每个头的条件方差，构建后置核方差头。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种后置核方差头，从单个VLA策略的嵌入中估计认知不确定性，用于自适应机器人学习，无需修改原始策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，提出高效的不确定性估计方法，用于改进VLA策略的自适应学习和求助决策，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) promise energy-efficient inference through sparse, event-driven computation, yet remain constrained on continuous, context-dependent tasks such as automatic speech recognition (ASR). A key bottleneck is the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron, whose membrane decay erases information across pauses and phonetic boundaries while it must both extract features and retain long-range context. Inspired by cortical separation of nonlinear filtering and somatic integration, we introduce the Spiking Ternary GRU (stGRU): a ternary-weight gated recurrent unit performs temporal filtering, while downstream Resonate-and-Fire (RF) neurons generate the binary spike stream driving the next block's event pathway. This makes binary event transmission a native training constraint rather than a separate deployment-time activation quantization step; together with ternary weights, learned projections avoid dense floating-point matrix MACs. Trained end-to-end on LibriSpeech-960, Small, Medium, and Large stGRUs reach 8.09%, 7.04%, and $6.44 \pm 0.17\%$ WER on test-clean without an external language model. To our knowledge, these are the first matrix-MAC-free spiking networks without a learned ANN sequence decoder to achieve single-digit WER on LibriSpeech. The architecture also achieves 10.88% test CER on Aishell-1 (9.28% on dev) when trained from scratch. Internally, trained networks develop a depth-graded hierarchy: shallow layers act as fast acoustic filters, while deep layers form slower semantic integrators whose latent representations segregate into part-of-speech manifolds and word-level spike events. Deep-layer firing rates follow lognormal distributions with a sparsity gradient, mirroring hierarchical processing observed in human cortex in vivo. Our biologically grounded architecture combines competitive ASR with favorable modeled compute and memory cost.

analysis.key_results: 在LibriSpeech-960上，Small/Medium/Large stGRU分别达到8.09%、7.04%、6.44±0.17%的测试集WER；在Aishell-1上达到10.88%测试CER（9.28% dev CER）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Spiking Ternary GRU (stGRU)架构，通过三值权重和事件驱动脉冲传输实现无矩阵乘法的语音识别，并在LibriSpeech上首次达到个位数WER。
analysis.method: 三值权重门控循环单元（stGRU）与共振-发放（RF）神经元结合，端到端训练，利用事件驱动计算和三值权重避免密集浮点矩阵运算。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种结合三值权重GRU与共振-发放神经元的事件驱动脉冲神经网络，在语音识别任务上实现无矩阵乘法的低能耗推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于脉冲神经网络的高效推理与量化，不直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作-世界建模。但其模型量化和事件驱动计算技术对机器人高效推理可能有借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: We present SpatialDex, a framework that learns 3D-grounded bimanual dexterity from RGB-only human videos through reconstruction-augmented visuomotor pre-training. The central idea is to learn human behavior together with its spatial context. From each video, we reconstruct the scene geometry and estimate the hand motion, align them at a shared video-level scale using the hand-size prior of 3D hand estimates. We retain the reconstructed geometry as both a policy input and a prediction target. The policy grounds the token grid of a pre-trained vision-language model in this geometry through gated residual fusion, is trained to predict future scene geometry alongside wrist and finger actions, and generates finger motion conditioned on the predicted trajectories of both wrists. Pre-trained on 1M human-video clips and fine-tuned with a small number of robot demonstrations, SpatialDex outperforms the state-of-the-art methods by 16.5 points on nine simulated dexterous tasks across two embodiments and by 38.3 points on six real-world bimanual dexterous tasks. Under a matched comparison, pre-training with reconstructed geometry improves success by 14.2 points over pre-training on hand motion alone.

analysis.key_results: 在9个仿真灵巧任务上超越SOTA方法16.5个百分点，在6个真实世界双手灵巧任务上超越38.3个百分点；匹配对比中，使用重建几何预训练比仅使用手部运动预训练成功率提高14.2个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SpatialDex，利用人类视频中的重建几何作为策略输入和预测目标，通过门控残差融合将预训练视觉语言模型的token网格锚定于几何，实现3D锚定的双手灵巧策略学习。
analysis.method: 从RGB人类视频重建场景几何和手部运动，以手部尺寸先验对齐，保留重建几何作为策略输入和预测目标；策略通过门控残差融合将VLM token网格锚定于几何，预测未来场景几何及手腕和手指动作，以预测的双腕轨迹条件生成手指运动；在100万人类视频片段上预训练，少量机器人演示微调。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SpatialDex框架，通过重建增强的视觉运动预训练从RGB人类视频中学习3D锚定的双手灵巧操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于VLA范畴，核心在于使用重建几何作为视觉和语言之外的模态输入与监督信号，提升双手灵巧操作的策略学习，与机器人动作预测和世界建模高度相关。

papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) show promising reasoning capabilities, but reliable physical interaction requires planning that accounts for when actions are executable and how they change the world. These preconditions and effects are environment-dependent and often not captured by MLLMs, making adaptation challenging. Yet existing approaches either require costly environment-specific training or rely on unstructured interaction experience that is difficult to reuse. Therefore, we introduce CausGround, a non-parametric causal interaction grounding framework that distills interaction experience into reusable action-centered causal knowledge. CausGround identifies action preconditions and effects and organizes them in a factorized world-state representation capturing object attributes and inter-object relations. At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in current observations to support backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for action selection and multi-step planning. We evaluate CausGround on simulated high-level planning, interaction reasoning, and real-world robot manipulation. On adapted VirtualHome and RoboCasa benchmarks, CausGround improves vision-based high-level planning across MLLM backbones, increasing average task success from 24.9% to 53.3% on VirtualHome and closed-loop planning success from 43.0% to 57.0% on RoboCasa. On SWITCH, average interaction reasoning accuracy increases from 25.8% to 31.9%, indicating improved action selection, recovery, and verification. Moreover, real-world experiments show that CausGround reasons backward from MLLM-interpreted goals to derive executable high-level action sequences for sequential manipulation. These results demonstrate that reusable action preconditions and effects support long-horizon embodied planning across diverse environments without parameter updates.

analysis.key_results: 在VirtualHome上平均任务成功率从24.9%提升至53.3%，在RoboCasa闭环规划成功率从43.0%提升至57.0%，在SWITCH上平均交互推理准确率从25.8%提升至31.9%，并在真实机器人操作中验证了从MLLM解释的目标反向推理生成可执行高层动作序列。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CausGround框架，通过提取动作前置条件和效果并组织为分解的世界状态表示，在规划时将任务相关因果依赖接地到当前观测，支持后向推理前置条件和前向推理效果，用于动作选择和多步规划。
analysis.method: 非参数因果交互接地框架，提取动作前置条件和效果，组织为分解的世界状态表示，并在规划时进行任务相关因果依赖的接地。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个非参数因果交互接地框架CausGround，将交互经验提炼为可复用的动作中心因果知识，以支持无需参数更新的长时程具身规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的规划能力，通过因果知识接地提升行动选择和多步规划，适用于机器人操作任务，对本站VLA和世界模型主题具有高度相关性。

At planning time, task-relevant causal dependencies are grounded in the current observation to form a local causal graph, supporting backward reasoning over preconditions and forward reasoning over effects for executable long-horizon planning without parameter updates.

papers.abstract: During steady pouring, images and robot pose may remain nearly unchanged while transferred mass accumulates, making the return decision ambiguous for a whole-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy. We present FlowVLA, which separates motor generation from physical-completion estimation. A shared $\pi_{0.5}$ action expert learns approach, pour, and return with boundary-aware supervision. A target-independent estimator fuses visual, joint, wrist-wrench, and recurrent force-belief histories to maintain an estimate of transferred mass. The controller initiates return when this estimate plus predicted residual outflow reaches the requested mass. In coffee-pot/water experiments, FlowVLA achieves 13.1 g goal-balanced mean absolute error (MacroMAE), lower than all tested VLA baselines. Across all attempts, 53.7% both complete the task and finish within +/-10% of the requested mass. The same model interpolates to held-out 150/250-g targets without retraining. Independently trained models further evaluate the formulation in three additional container-fluid settings.

analysis.key_results: 在咖啡壶/水实验中，FlowVLA的MacroMAE为13.1克，优于所有测试的VLA基线；53.7%的尝试完成任务且误差在±10%内；模型可在未重新训练的情况下泛化到150/250克目标。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FlowVLA框架，将电机控制与物理完成估计分离，利用边界感知监督训练动作专家，并用融合视觉、关节、腕力与循环力信念历史的估计器维护转移质量，从而在定量倒水任务中实现更高精度。
analysis.method: 共享的π0.5动作专家学习接近、倾倒和返回，配合目标无关的估计器融合多模态信息预测转移质量，控制器在估计值加预测残余流出达到目标质量时触发返回。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FlowVLA将动作生成与物理完成估计解耦，通过共享动作专家和独立质量估计器实现定量倒水任务。

papers.abstract: Generative image compression (GIC) delivers strong perceptual quality at low bitrates. However, GIC methods with strong perceptual quality often rely on pretrained diffusion models with high latency, while recent lightweight GIC methods reduce latency but deliver lower perceptual quality. We observe that, for lightweight GIC methods at low bitrates, coarse deterministic quantization can collapse nearby encoder latents corresponding to different fine details to the same point, making these details difficult to recover. Motivated by this, we propose GR-GIC, an efficient GIC that delivers competitive reconstruction performance with fast inference. For better performance, we introduce Guided Refinement (GR), which combines latent refinement guided by entropy context with adaptive perturbations for training regularization, jointly improving reconstruction at low bitrates. For fast inference, we introduce reorganized projected residual vector quantization (P-RVQ), which equivalently reorganizes residual updates into low-dimensional lookups to expose greater parallelism and reduce sequential computation. Experiments on Kodak show that for performance, compared with OneDC, GR-GIC achieves BD-rate savings of 23.19%, 37.71%, 22.30%, and 22.14% for LPIPS, DISTS, PSNR, and FID, respectively. For fast inference, the highly optimized implementation of GR-GIC encodes and decodes in 4.60 and 5.98 ms on an NVIDIA A100. Specifically, the reorganized P-RVQ implementation achieves a $3.14\times$ average speedup over the original implementation under the same FP32 setting. On an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX, GR-GIC achieves latency comparable to lightweight GIC methods.

analysis.key_results: 在Kodak数据集上，与OneDC相比，GR-GIC在LPIPS、DISTS、PSNR和FID上分别实现23.19%、37.71%、22.30%和22.14%的BD-rate节省；在NVIDIA A100上编码和解码时间分别为4.60 ms和5.98 ms；重组P-RVQ实现3.14倍平均加速；在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX上延迟与轻量GIC方法相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GR-GIC，通过引导细化(GR)和重组投影残差向量量化(P-RVQ)同时提升低码率重建性能和推理速度。
analysis.method: 引导细化(GR)结合熵上下文引导的潜变量细化和自适应扰动训练正则化；重组投影残差向量量化(P-RVQ)将残差更新重组为低维查找以增强并行性并减少顺序计算。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出GR-GIC，一种结合引导细化和重组投影残差向量量化(P-RVQ)的高效生成式图像压缩方法，在低码率下实现高质量重建和快速推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究生成式图像压缩中的向量量化与推理加速，不涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人动作预测。其量化与高效推理方法可能为机器人视觉编码提供参考，但无直接关系。

papers.abstract: The deployment of small and quantized language models in resource-constrained settings raises an important fairness question: when a compressed model produces fewer biased responses, does this reflect fairer behavior or greater abstention? We study this problem in Question Answering (QA) using the BBQ benchmark across multiple model sizes and quantization settings from Qwen3, Gemma-3, and SmolLM2. We also examine whether the observed trends remain stable across alternative prompt formulations and when the ``Unknown'' option is removed in a forced-choice setting. Our results show that larger models achieved higher QA accuracy, but bias showed no simple scaling trend and quantization effects varied across configurations. Notably, 20 of the 26 configurations with fewer biased responses also show increased over-abstention, indicating that lower observed bias can partly reflect greater abstention. These findings show that lower observed bias can partly reflect greater abstention, and that fairness evaluation should consider biased responses, abstention, prompt formulation, and answer-option design jointly.

analysis.key_results: 较大模型QA准确率更高，但偏见无简单缩放规律，量化影响因配置而异；20/26个偏见较少的配置中过度弃答增加。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示模型规模与量化对QA中社会偏见和弃答的复杂影响，并强调公平性评估需同时考虑偏见、弃答、提示设计和选项设计。
analysis.method: 在BBQ基准上，对Qwen3、Gemma-3和SmolLM2等多个模型及量化配置进行实验，分析偏见和弃答趋势，并检验不同提示表述和强制选择设置下的稳定性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究量化和小型语言模型在问答中社会偏见与弃答行为的关系，发现低偏见可能部分源于过度弃答。

papers.abstract: Digital image transmission typically optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately, limiting how source representations adapt to channel impairments. We propose SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation scheme for generative image transmission converting source to modulated symbols, such as standard QAM symbols. Channel impairments create two challenges: they can corrupt the latent representation at the receiver, and this corruption can compound through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction quality. First, SemQAM represents latent features with vector quantization (VQ), maps each VQ index to a QAM symbol, and updates the codeword corresponding to the detected symbol so that channel impairments directly affect codebook learning. Moreover, SemQAM uses the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction and reduce error propagation during autoregressive coding. SemQAM supports multiple SNRs and CBRs in a unified model, while also supporting conventional source coding through SemQAM-C. Experiments show that (i) under the same LDPC and QAM settings, SemQAM-C outperforms OneDC in LPIPS and DISTS with substantially lower complexity, showing that the unified model retains competitive capability for source coding. (ii) Compared with this separated counterpart, SemQAM reduces channel uses by 18.57% at matched LPIPS and outperforms the compared JSCC methods, demonstrating the benefit of joint coding.

analysis.key_results: 在相同 LDPC 和 QAM 设置下，SemQAM-C 在 LPIPS 和 DISTS 上优于 OneDC 且复杂度更低；与分离方案相比，SemQAM 在相同 LPIPS 下减少 18.57% 的信道使用，并优于对比的 JSCC 方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SemQAM，将矢量量化与 QAM 调制相结合，实现联合语义信道编码与调制，并支持多 SNR 和 CBR 的统一模型。
analysis.method: 使用矢量量化表示潜在特征，将 VQ 索引映射到 QAM 符号，并通过接收码字的条件期望来降低自回归编码中的误差传播。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 SemQAM，一种联合语义信道编码与调制的生成式图像传输方案，利用矢量量化和 QAM 符号映射来提升传输效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于生成式图像传输中的矢量量化与信道编码，与 VLA/WAM 或机器人策略无直接关系；但矢量量化技术对模型压缩和高效推理有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Edge medical segmentation must reconcile small model size, high accuracy, and fast inference. TernScope addresses this tradeoff through model--hardware co-design, learning a compact segmentation network whose low-bit operators also simplify hardware execution. Split-channel large-kernel blocks preserve spatial context with limited computation, while branch fusion removes redundant inference paths. Ternary Progressive Quantization-aware Training (TPQ) then adapts the fused network from deep to shallow layers, through the decoder, and finally to the input and prediction layers. All 25 convolutions use ternary weights and 8-bit activations, enabling packed storage and multiplier-free computation. The resulting model uses 0.2483 M parameters and 0.0949 GMACs while retaining competitive segmentation accuracy on in-domain and external datasets. Under the same 45 nm technology, TernScope reduces compute-array area by 88.46% compared with the original Gemmini, a systolic-array accelerator with 8-bit $\times$ 8-bit multipliers. These results demonstrate a path from accurate lightweight medical segmentation to compact low-bit hardware.

analysis.key_results: 模型参数0.2483M，计算量0.0949 GMACs，在域内和外部数据集上保持有竞争力的分割精度；与8位乘法的Gemmini systolic-array加速器相比，计算阵列面积减少88.46%（45nm工艺）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TernScope方法，结合模型-硬件协同设计，将紧凑分割网络与三值量化感知训练结合，实现低参数、低计算量的高能效分割，并在硬件层面显著减少计算阵列面积。
analysis.method: 采用分割通道大核块以保留空间上下文，分支融合去除冗余推理路径，并应用三值渐进量化感知训练（TPQ），使所有25个卷积使用三值权重和8位激活。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TernScope通过模型-硬件协同设计与三值量化感知训练实现了高能效的内窥镜分割。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于医学图像分割的模型量化与硬件协同设计，未涉及视觉语言动作模型或世界模型，但所提低比特量化与硬件加速方法对机器人视觉模型的高效推理具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models achieve strong performance across embodied manipulation tasks by unifying visual understanding, language conditioning, and action generation. However, long-horizon tasks can involve non-Markovian dependencies: successful decisions may require retaining task progress and past interaction outcomes, while partial observability and execution errors compound over time. Existing work has begun to address these challenges by augmenting foundation-model policies with memory and by introducing hierarchical architectures that separate high-level planning from low-level execution. We organize the high-level VLM as a robotic agent through an editable harness to maintain task context and improve planning through execution experience. We instantiate this approach as SERA (Self-Evolving Robotic Agent), with a fixed VLA executor providing low-level control. The harness maintains and updates task context using observations and execution feedback to guide subsequent planning. Self-evolution uses environment rollouts to propose and evaluate harness revisions, with the selected configuration fixed before held-out testing. On RoboMME, SERA achieves 51.38% overall success with autonomous selection, compared with 44.38% without self-evolution. Our exploration suggests that agentic planning is a promising direction for history-dependent robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboMME上，SERA自演化选择后总体成功率达51.38%，未自演化为44.38%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SERA（Self-Evolving Robotic Agent），将高层VLM组织为机器人智能体，通过可编辑框架维护任务上下文并利用执行经验改进规划，实现自演化。
analysis.method: 固定VLA执行器提供低层控制，可编辑框架利用观测和执行反馈维护并更新任务上下文，通过环境rollout提议和评估框架修订，选定配置后进行测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出SERA系统，通过可编辑的框架将高层VLM规划器与固定VLA执行器结合，以自演化方式维持任务上下文并提升历史依赖操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接扩展VLA模型在长程历史依赖操作任务中的能力，核心为VLA执行器与高层VLM规划器的结合，属于VLA应用与机器人操作策略学习范畴，对本站VLA主题具有直接研究价值。

papers.abstract: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.

analysis.key_results: 在4B到35B参数的混合模型上，PACE（混合4/8比特头）在内存约八比特DAMP的2/3下达到相当性能；纯四比特头PACE在相同内存下优于Q-Mamba；周期性轮询保持解码加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入PACE，一种后训练四比特状态量化器，通过周期性轮询、通道对齐量化和混合精度头减少循环状态量化误差。
analysis.method: PACE采用周期性轮询（每几个token量化一次）、通道对齐量化（共享量化尺度）、混合精度头（部分头保持八比特）。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种后训练四比特状态量化器PACE，通过周期性轮询、通道对齐量化和混合精度头来降低线性注意力语言模型循环状态的内存占用。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

analysis.key_results: RCSD在多个基准上平均接受长度比HASS提升35%，端到端推理速度比HASS快1.35倍，且不损失生成质量。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了RCSD（Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding）训练框架，将草稿模型优化与系统级目标（最大化接受长度）对齐，利用推测推理中自然产生的接受/拒绝序列构建偏好对，并引入掩码损失避免惩罚目标对齐的token。
analysis.method: 强化学习与持续学习相结合；利用推测推理过程中的接受和拒绝序列作为隐式偏好对；使用掩码损失防止惩罚与目标模型对齐的token。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RCSD训练框架，通过强化与持续学习优化推测解码中的草稿模型，以最大化接受长度并加速推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型推测解码的效率优化，未直接涉及VLA（视觉-语言-动作）、WAM（世界-动作模型）或机器人任务。然而，其训练框架和系统级优化思想可潜在迁移到机器人策略模型或多模态VLA中的自回归解码加速。

papers.abstract: Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under user actions, but most existing systems assume one controlled agent and one task-specific action interface. We study multi-agent video world modeling, where one model generates a joint visual future for multiple controlled agents while interpreting heterogeneous controls ranging from binary game buttons to continuous robot commands. This task presents two complementary challenges. First, every agent-indexed action stream must control its intended visual entity independently. Second, the model must adapt the meaning of each control variable across different tasks, where the same tensor dimension may denote an attack, steering command, or robot command. We introduce LiveAct, centered on a Heterogeneous Action Interface (HAI) whose two components mirror this decomposition. To support independent control, Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation uses language-driven spatial gates and agent-specific attention to bind each action stream to its intended visual agent. To accommodate heterogeneous controls, Schema-Guided Action Adaptation describes each control variable in language and modulates its semantic token with the synchronized numerical value. We further transfer the complete interface to a blockwise causal generator through teacher forcing and rollout-aware distribution matching, enabling efficient streaming generation while retaining agent-specific control and action semantics. We instantiate the formulation on six multi-agent sources spanning games and multi-robot manipulation, and evaluate visual quality, action following, agent attribution, and latency. Across games and robot manipulation, LiveAct reaches 0.898 and 0.942 agent-attribution accuracy without agent locations or identity crops, and the causal generator attains 17.70 FPS at $512\times 448$.

analysis.key_results: 在游戏和机器人操作中达到0.898和0.942的代理归因准确率，因果生成器在512×448分辨率下达到17.70 FPS。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LiveAct及异构动作接口HAI，通过代理感知空间调制和模式引导动作适配解决多智能体独立控制和异构控制问题，并迁移到块状因果生成器实现实时流式生成。
analysis.method: Agent-Aware Spatial Modulation（语言驱动空间门控和代理特定注意力）与Schema-Guided Action Adaptation（语言描述控制变量并调制语义令牌），结合教师强制和rollout感知分布匹配迁移到因果生成器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出LiveAct与异构动作接口HAI，用于多智能体视频世界建模，支持独立控制和异构控制，并实现实时因果生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接面向世界模型（WAM），并在多机器人操作场景中验证，涉及视觉未来预测和机器人命令，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B的2位和3位量化上，OnQ取得九项基准平均最优，长程推理提升最大；2位时在所有基准和模型规模上均优于基线，Qwen3-8B平均分比最强基线高10.26分，且生成响应更短、截断和重复错误更少。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出OnQ低比特恢复流水线，结合on-policy蒸馏和候选级动态KL散度，解决量化模型在长程推理任务上的性能下降和终止问题。
analysis.method: OnQ使用块级校准初始化，量化学生模型自生成响应，教师模型对学生自身前缀进行监督；动态KL根据教师-学生概率比调整前向与反向KL权重，以校正欠预测和过预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出OnQ，一种结合on-policy蒸馏和候选级动态KL散度的量化感知训练流程，以恢复低比特LLM的长序列推理能力。

papers.abstract: Learning-based path planners based on diffusion and flow matching can generate diverse trajectories from demonstrations but typically lack mechanisms for constraint satisfaction and collision avoidance during deployment. This work proposes a framework that combines flow-matching-based path planning with model predictive path-following control to integrate data-driven path generation with real-time, constraint-aware execution. The flow-matching model captures multimodal path distributions, while the predictive controller adapts motion online to satisfy state and input constraints and avoid obstacles using updated local sensor information. An event-triggered re-planning scheme incorporates predictive control solutions into subsequent path generation, promoting collision-free navigation in environments with previously unseen obstacles. Simulation results for mobile robot navigation demonstrate robust performance across cluttered environments. The framework provides a systematic approach to combining flow matching with predictive control for adaptive, data-driven navigation.

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种将流匹配路径规划与模型预测路径跟随控制相结合的框架，以实现约束感知和避障的机器人导航。

papers.abstract: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to remember task-relevant information beyond its short observation window. Existing memory-augmented policies typically retrieve relevant information from history and reason over it at execution time, placing a heavy reasoning burden on the high-level model. To address this challenge, we propose PAL (\textbf{P}lan first, \textbf{A}ct \textbf{L}ater), a hierarchical memory framework for vision-language robot manipulation. It maintains a short-term visual buffer, a semantic-event memory, and an executable \texttt{subtask\_list}. A high-level vision-language model (VLM) converts streaming visual observations into the \texttt{subtask\_list}. At execution time, the VLM selects the currently relevant subtask from the \texttt{subtask\_list} and passes it to a low-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy. To teach the model what to write to memory and when to update it, we introduce a two-stage data generation procedure that first expands sparse update supervision and then uses self-labeling with task-grounded verification to generate training data that better match the state distribution encountered during execution. We evaluate our approach on memory-dependent benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. On RoboMME, PAL achieves a \textbf{56.05\%} success rate, outperforming the strongest baseline, FrameSamp-Modul, at 44.51\%. In real-world experiments across four manipulation tasks, \pal{} reaches \textbf{60.83\%} overall success, surpassing MemER (45.00\%) and FrameSamp-Modul (28.33\%). These results show that proactively writing future-relevant subtasks into hierarchical memory improves long-horizon visual reasoning and robot control. Code and videos can be found on our website: https://qinghangliu.github.io/pal-webpage/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboMME基准上，PAL取得56.05%成功率，超过最强基线FrameSamp-Modul（44.51%）；在四个真实世界操作任务中，PAL总成功率达60.83%，超过MemER（45.00%）和FrameSamp-Modul（28.33%）。

analysis.method: 维护短期视觉缓冲、语义事件记忆和可执行子任务列表；高层VLM将视觉观察转化为子任务列表，执行时选择相关子任务传递给低层VLA策略；采用两阶段数据生成过程，先扩展稀疏更新监督，再利用自标注和任务基验证生成与执行状态分布更匹配的训练数据。

papers.abstract: Recent electroencephalography (EEG) foundation models increasingly emphasize model scale, potentially limiting their deployment on resource-constrained devices and in everyday environments. We argue that transferable EEG features can instead be learned with a compact architecture and introduce BrainCodes, a lightweight foundation model pretrained through self-supervised learning on more than 800 hours of recordings from over 1,000 participants. Our architecture combines a quantization-based neural tokenizer with a spatiotemporal encoder that supports arbitrary electrode configurations. The pretraining objective explicitly encourages representations that capture spatial connectivity through channel positional encoding, and sensitivity to narrowband neural oscillations through an auxiliary training objective. Our model matches or surpasses the state of the art across diverse neurophysiological monitoring tasks, including sleep staging, attention assessment, and cognitive load estimation. BrainCodes transfers effectively to low-resource wearable devices while using up to 97% fewer trainable parameters than comparable architectures. Beyond predictive accuracy, our evaluation framework characterizes the geometry and invariances of learned EEG representations across measurable spatial, temporal, and spectral signal properties.

analysis.key_results: 在睡眠分期、注意力评估和认知负荷估计等任务上匹配或超越现有最优模型，同时参数减少高达 97%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个轻量级脑电图基础模型 BrainCodes，通过量化神经 tokenizer 和自监督学习，在多个神经监测任务上达到最优或相当性能，同时参数减少高达 97%。
analysis.method: 使用基于量化的神经 tokenizer 和时空编码器，通过通道位置编码捕获空间连接，并通过辅助训练目标增强对窄带神经振荡的敏感性，在超过 800 小时脑电图数据上进行自监督预训练。

papers.abstract: Language models are being explored as the interface through which space robots interpret operator commands and select among verified skills. Running them onboard calls for low-bit compression, and flight use adds requirements that generic post-training quantization leaves implicit: a fixed memory budget and storage format, a static artifact under configuration control, and behavior close to the full-precision model validated on the ground. We treat compression as a ground-segment step and study QSelect, which composes one static low-bit model from compatible AWQ, GPTQ, and AutoRound checkpoints by assigning each linear module to one quantizer family and scoring every substitution at the final next-token distribution. The default fidelity mode needs no labels or tuned thresholds and accepts a substitution only when the forward KL divergence from the BF16 reference decreases; an optional target-adapted mode adds answer likelihood on a small labeled set. On DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Llama-3.2-3B at 3 and 4 bits, composed models reach lower mean held-out perplexity than every single-family model in all six settings, and the fidelity mode lowers perplexity and KL further. In a matched scaffold, final-output scoring gives lower held-out KL than representation-similarity scoring in all 12 paired runs. With labels from training or development splits of the evaluated task families, the target-adapted mode raises 3-bit pooled accuracy on the two Llama models by 4.3 and 4.5 points over the best single-family model. At 3 bits, unquantized embedding and output layers make up 43-46% of the packed artifact. All evaluations use general-domain benchmarks on a ground GPU; space-domain tasks and flight hardware are left to future work.

analysis.key_results: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B、Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.2-3B上3/4比特量化，组合模型困惑度均低于单一家族模型；目标适配模式在3比特下将两个Llama模型的准确率提高4.3和4.5个百分点；3比特量化时未量化的嵌入和输出层占打包模型的43-46%。

analysis.main_contribution: 提出QSelect，将不同量化器家族（AWQ、GPTQ、AutoRound）的模块组合成一个静态低比特模型，并基于最终下一词元分布上的KL散度进行替换评分，在无标签和有标签两种模式下提升压缩模型保真度。
analysis.method: QSelect组合多个量化器家族的低比特模块，默认保真度模式仅接受降低BF16参考模型前向KL散度的替换；可选目标适配模式使用少量标注数据提高答案似然。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出QSelect方法，通过组合多种量化方案并基于行为保真度评估，为空间机器人机载语言模型生成静态低比特压缩模型。

papers.abstract: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning. They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.

analysis.key_results: 模型能识别大类活动，但难以识别咳嗽、打喷嚏、哈欠等细粒度动作；时间线重建不准确；会幻觉出涉及物体的动作；简单的热输入预处理和额外推理仅带来有限且依赖模型的改进；拒绝回答行为在不同模型间差异很大。
analysis.main_contribution: 填补了视觉语言模型在热成像人类活动理解中失效模式研究的空白，通过在两个以人为中心的热成像数据集上的诊断任务，揭示了模型在细粒度动作识别、时间线重建和幻觉等方面的不足。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 评估了七个本地可部署的视觉语言模型在热成像人机交互场景下理解人类活动的失效模式。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

analysis.key_results: Think-Capture-4B 在 MindCube-Tiny 上达到 54.4%（比主干高 21.5 分），在 MMSI-Bench 位置子集上 39.1%（+7.9），在 ViewSpatial 上 42.8%（+5.2），且在坐标和掩码扰动下保持鲁棒；完整堆栈适配单张 24GB GPU，并作为 Agibot G1 上的异步高层推理器。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: Think-Capture 提出查询条件式主动三维几何获取框架，通过符号化三维状态抽象和分层 GRPO 训练，提升视觉语言模型在多视角遮挡下的空间推理能力。
