papers.title: Perceives but Doesn't Brake: A Perception-Action Binding Gap in Reasoning Driving VLAs
papers.title_zh: 感知却不刹车：推理驾驶VLA中的感知-动作绑定缺口

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies increasingly reason before acting, but existing reasoning models compress this intermediate decision into a single representation. When several plans are valid, this commitment hides alternatives that could otherwise be selected or revised. We introduce the Generative Plan Latent (GPL), which represents the reasoning state as a low-dimensional conditional distribution over plans, such as which object, grasp, or route to use. This makes the reasoning state addressable: without retraining the VLA, plans can be sampled (coverage), selected on request (steering), and reweighted by deployment outcomes (outcome adaptation). We test all three on SimplerEnv manipulation with $\pi_0$, and extend the analysis to RoboCasa, LIBERO, and a maze domain. Steering the plan raises the fraction of executions that follow the request from 0.48 to 0.94, while the same guidance on the native action distribution shows no reliable gain. Finally, we show that an explicit plan is most useful when it carries decision information not already determined by the observation.

analysis.key_results: 在SimplerEnv操作任务中，将执行遵循请求的比例从0.48提升至0.94；对原生动作分布的相同引导无可靠增益；并扩展至RoboCasa、LIBERO和迷宫环境。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入生成式计划潜变量（GPL），使VLA的中间推理状态成为可寻址的计划分布，并展示了其在覆盖、引导和结果自适应方面的能力。
analysis.method: 生成式计划潜变量（GPL），将推理状态表示为计划（如物体、抓取方式或路径）的低维条件分布，并在采样、引导和结果自适应任务中测试。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出生成式计划潜变量，将VLA的推理状态表示为计划上的低维条件分布，使计划无需重训即可被采样、选择与结果自适应调整。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文以视觉-语言-动作模型为核心，改进其推理与计划表示，使其可覆盖、引导和依据结果自适应，对VLA策略的灵活性与可控性有直接贡献。

papers.title: Reasoning as a Distribution: Generative Plan Latents for Vision-Language-Action Models

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance on standard robotic manipulation benchmarks. However, their reliability can degrade substantially when task conditions deviate from the nominal setting. Perturbations in object positions and task instructions may lead to complete task failure. Existing VLA policies generally lack an explicit runtime mechanism for distinguishing these failure modes and selecting an appropriate recovery strategy. To systematically mitigate this issue, we propose FIT-MAC, a failure-aware, closed-loop multi-agent control framework for improving the robustness of VLA policies at inference time. FIT-MAC augments a VLA policy with an inference-time control layer. First, the Planner Agent parses the language instruction into a structured task specification that captures the manipulation goal and spatial constraints, and the Grounder Agent resolves each instruction-level reference to a visual target. Next, the Verifier Agent tracks phase-specific execution progress, distinguishes target-binding errors from local execution failures, and determines whether intervention is warranted. The Correction Agent then routes permitted interventions to target rebinding or bounded grasping or placement recovery, depending on the failure type. When no intervention is required, the pretrained VLA remains the default action generator. Extensive experiments on LIBERO-PRO demonstrate that FIT-MAC improves robustness across multiple VLA backbones, consistently increasing success rates and achieving state-of-the-art performance under diverse perturbations.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-PRO上的大量实验表明，FIT-MAC在多个VLA骨干网络上持续提高成功率，并在多种扰动下达到最先进性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FIT-MAC，一种故障感知的闭环多智能体控制框架，通过在推理时对VLA策略增加控制层来系统性地缓解分布偏移下的任务失败。
analysis.method: 框架包含Planner Agent将指令解析为结构化任务规范，Grounder Agent将指令级引用解析为视觉目标，Verifier Agent跟踪执行进度并区分目标绑定错误与局部执行失败，Correction Agent根据失败类型路由到目标重新绑定或有界抓取/放置恢复；无干预时使用预训练VLA。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个故障感知的闭环多智能体框架FIT-MAC，在推理时通过规划、接地、验证和纠正四个代理提高VLA策略在扰动下的鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型在分布偏移下的可靠性问题，通过推理时闭环多智能体控制框架提升机器人操作鲁棒性，与VLA主题高度相关。

papers.title: FIT-MAC: A Closed-Loop Multi-Agent Framework for Robust Vision-Language-Action Models

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies are commonly deployed with asynchronous inference in real-world settings, where the next action chunk is generated while the robot is still executing the previous one. By the time the new chunk is committed, the robot and scene have changed, so the chunk is conditioned on a stale observation and task success drops sharply as this inference delay grows. Generating multiple candidate chunks could let newer observations inform the final choice, but existing multi-candidate methods either rank candidates with the stale inference-start observation or repeatedly switch between candidates during execution, which can make the executed action sequence discontinuous. Our key insight is that inference delay can be used as decision time. While candidate generation is still underway, candidate selection can reuse the VLA itself to choose the complete action chunk that best fits a later observation. We propose PACT-VLA, a training-free framework that generates candidates from the inference-start observation and selects one using this pre-commit observation. Its scoring function, FlowRes, measures the residual between each candidate's implied flow direction and the velocity predicted by the frozen policy under the pre-commit observation, requiring no separate verifier. A pipelined implementation overlaps observation processing with candidate generation and batches scoring, so selection adds no control-step delay on the evaluated hardware. At a four-step delay, PACT-VLA improves average success by 15.0 percentage points over RTC on Kinetix and by 5.2 points over single-candidate asynchronous execution with GR00T N1.7 on LIBERO, and it further improves existing delay-robust methods. On three real-robot tasks, it raises average success from 60% to 82% over naive asynchronous execution with the same frozen $\pi_{0.5}$ checkpoint.

analysis.key_results: 在四步延迟下，PACT-VLA 在 Kinetix 上平均成功率比 RTC 高 15.0 个百分点，在 LIBERO 上比单候选异步执行（GR00T N1.7）高 5.2 个百分点；三个真实机器人任务平均成功率从 60% 提高到 82%（与同一冻结 π0.5 检查点的朴素异步执行相比）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出训练无关框架 PACT-VLA，生成多个候选动作块并用预提交观测选择最佳块，引入 FlowRes 评分函数无需独立验证器，且流水线实现不增加控制步延迟。
analysis.method: 从推理开始观测生成候选动作块，使用预提交观测通过冻结 VLA 策略的 FlowRes 残差评分选择最佳候选，流水线重叠观测处理与候选生成并批量评分。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PACT-VLA 利用推断延迟作为决策时间，通过在选择时用 VLA 自身对预提交观测下的多个候选动作块进行评分，提高异步推理下 VLA 策略的任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对 VLA 策略在异步推理下的延迟鲁棒性问题，通过推测性动作块生成与验证提高效率与成功率，对 VLA 和机器人动作预测具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: A planner using a learned world model can improve its predicted outcome while choosing a worse action. We study when expected free energy (EFE) can help decide how much computation to spend on a plan. An EFE-inspired objective combines goal distance with disagreement among stochastic predictions. We test candidate scoring, stopping, and online predictor updates separately. Stopping when elite cost stalls reduces refinement on tasks whose success plateaus with depth, with mean success close to fixed-depth references. At the larger tested weights, rewarding disagreement lowers success with a frozen model. Penalizing it helps at some task and weight settings but harms others. When training data omit a region needed to reach the goal, online updates recover part of the resulting loss. The tested cost-stall rule can fail when further optimization exploits model errors, because predicted cost keeps falling after task success peaks. Cost progress can guide computation on a plateau, but protecting performance after a peak requires information about the consequences of the chosen actions.

analysis.key_results: 停止准则在精英成本停滞时能减少优化，平均成功率接近固定深度参考；在较大权重下奖励不一致性会降低成功率，惩罚不一致性在某些任务和权重设置下有益；在线更新可恢复部分因训练数据缺失导致的性能损失；成本停滞准则可能因模型错误而在真实任务成功率下降后仍持续优化。
analysis.limitations: 成本停滞规则可能失败，因为进一步优化会利用模型错误，导致预测成本持续下降但任务成功率已见顶；需要关于动作后果的信息来保护性能峰值后的表现。
analysis.main_contribution: 将期望自由能启发式目标（结合目标距离与随机预测不一致性）作为测试时计算控制器，系统剖析其在潜在世界模型规划中的作用与局限。
analysis.method: 提出EFE启发式目标，分别测试候选评分、精英成本停滞停止准则和在线预测更新，并在多任务上评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了在基于学习世界模型的规划中，使用期望自由能（EFE）启发的目标来决定投入多少计算量，并分别测试了候选评分、停止准则和在线预测更新。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究世界模型规划中的测试时计算控制，虽未直接涉及VLA或机器人动作世界模型，但其对世界模型规划效率和可靠性分析可为本站在世界模型和机器人学习方向的方法论提供参考。

papers.abstract: Learning loco-manipulation policies requires demonstrations that capture coordinated base and arm motion on the target embodiment. Robot-free interfaces allow demonstrations to be collected independently of the target robot, increasing flexibility but without directly capturing platform-specific commands, proprioception, and body-mounted observations. On-robot teleoperation allows to capture these signals directly, but requires an interface capable of commanding the complete system concurrently. This paper presents LocoPilot, a single-operator bilateral teleoperation and data-collection framework implemented on a 12-DoF Unitree Go2 quadruped equipped with a 6-DoF AgileX Piper L manipulator, an Intel RealSense D435 wrist camera, and an Intel RealSense D405 head camera. A second 6-DoF Piper L arm, used as the leader and two handheld controllers provide simultaneous control of the base, body posture, manipulator, and gripper. The follower arm interaction forces are estimated without a dedicated force/torque sensor and rendered to the operator through a passivity-constrained haptic channel. A ROS~2 pipeline records synchronized multimodal observations together with a unified 11D action shared by teleoperation and policy deployment. Compared to prior work, LocoPilot uniquely unifies robot-in-the-loop legged data collection, force feedback without motion-capture instrumentation, and the same action interface at deployment. We evaluate the interface across multiple loco-manipulation tasks and validate the complete collection-to-deployment pipeline by fine-tuning MolmoAct2 \cite{MOLMO} on pick-and-place demonstrations and deploying on the physical robot without action retargeting or additional inverse kinematics. Code available at: https://github.com/iit-DLSLab/LocoPilot

analysis.key_results: 在多个移动操作任务上评估了接口，并在物理机器人上微调MolmoAct2后成功部署，验证了完整的采集-部署流水线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个统一的机器人参与式数据采集与策略部署框架，无需动作重定向或额外逆运动学，实现从演示到执行的端到端流水线。
analysis.method: 利用第二台机械臂作为领导者设备，结合两个手持控制器和被动性约束的触觉通道，实现对基座、躯干、机械臂和夹爪的同步控制；通过ROS 2记录同步多模态观测和统一的11维动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出LocoPilot，一个在四足机器人上实现单人双边遥操作的数据采集与部署一体化框架，用于学习移动操作策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接服务于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略学习，通过提供与部署一致的动作接口和同步多模态观测数据，实现机器人移动操作策略的端到端训练与部署，对VLA主题具有核心价值。

papers.abstract: A single observation can admit several plausible futures, making uncertainty an essential part of world modelling. However, quantum generative models remain underexplored for this task. We introduce Quantum-JEPA, a latent-action JEPA framework that learns distributions of future representations using a conditional quantum Born prior. Circuit measurements generate binary latent actions, which a shared predictor maps to alternative future representations. We train the quantum prior through the quality and diversity of these predictions using a sampled energy objective. Our model learns distinct continuations on constructed multimodal tasks and captures latent-action correlations that support coordinated multi-agent futures. On D3IL, a benchmark of diverse human demonstrations, our trained models generate multiple obstacle-crossing routes from a common starting point without observed motion. On the controlled tasks, our classical and quantum prior implementations improve prediction validity and distributional fidelity over the evaluated variational baselines. Our quantum priors combine competitive predictive quality with a parameter-efficient sampling structure: they avoid an exponentially sized categorical output layer while supporting correlated latent actions. We further validate finite-shot parameter-shift training, including training with readout noise. Unlike most prior work, which focuses on simulation, we also verify the feasibility of inference with trained priors on a real QPU. These results establish a trainable quantum component for JEPA future prediction and a basis for exploring quantum-enhanced world models at larger scales.

analysis.key_results: 在构造的多模态任务和D3IL基准上学习到不同延续，生成多条障碍跨越路径；相比变分基线提升预测有效性和分布保真度；展示了量子先验的参数高效采样结构和在真实QPU上的推理可行性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Quantum-JEPA框架，用条件量子Born先验生成潜在动作并映射到多种未来表示，以参数高效的方式对多模态未来分布建模。
analysis.method: 在JEPA框架中引入量子Born先验，电路测量生成二元潜在动作，通过共享预测器映射到未来表示，并用采样能量目标训练先验。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Quantum-JEPA，一种用条件量子Born先验学习未来表示分布的潜在动作JEPA框架，以提升世界模型中的不确定性建模。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该文属于世界模型范畴，与本站主题直接相关，但主要贡献是量子Born先验在JEPA中的应用，未涉及VLA或机器人动作生成，属于世界建模研究，对机器人领域有一定参考价值。

papers.abstract: History-dependent robotic manipulation requires task context and interaction history, as the current observation alone is insufficient to determine the next action. Hierarchical frameworks use task memory for high-level subgoal reasoning and low-level policies for execution. However, memory updates require accurate completion assessment: similar observations may correspond to different execution phases, and prematurely recording completion can mislead subsequent subgoal reasoning. We present EventSync, a hierarchical framework that coordinates task reasoning and action execution through event-driven memory updates. A vision-language model generates subgoals from task plans and interaction history, while a vision-language-action model executes them. A lightweight Event Monitor combines visual observations with end-effector trajectories to determine whether the current subgoal is complete. The framework records the current subgoal in its completed-subgoal history and triggers subsequent reasoning only after obtaining completion evidence. With visual history in the executor, EventSync achieves 64.5% overall success on RoboMME, exceeding the best baseline reported in the benchmark by 20.0 percentage points. Further analysis shows that this update mechanism helps build a reliable completed-subgoal history. Experiments on four real-robot tasks with different memory requirements validate the framework's effectiveness in real-world robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboMME基准上达到64.5%总体成功率，比该基准报告的最佳基线高出20.0个百分点；在四个具有不同记忆需求的真实机器人任务上验证了有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EventSync分层框架，通过事件驱动的记忆更新机制协调高层子目标推理与低层执行，避免错误记录子目标完成，提升任务成功率。
analysis.method: 使用视觉语言模型生成子目标，视觉语言动作模型执行动作，轻量级事件监视器结合视觉观察和末端执行器轨迹判断子目标完成，仅在获得完成证据后更新历史并触发后续推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: EventSync提出一种分层框架，通过事件驱动的记忆更新协调任务推理与动作执行，以处理历史相关的机器人操作任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接关注VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在真实机器人操作中的应用，提出通过事件驱动的记忆更新提升历史相关任务的策略性能，对VLA/机器人策略学习具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Real-world observations are noisy and often contain excessive task-irrelevant information. Effective world modeling and planning need to abstract observations into world state representations while filtering out irrelevant information. However, encoders in existing world models are typically non-adaptive, leading to state representations that are easily distracted by task-irrelevant information. As a result, the model may not selectively filter observations to cater to different task demands. To address this problem, we introduce ConfigWM, which realizes configurable perception through task-conditioned state extraction. Given a language description of the task at hand, ConfigWM uses it as a configuration signal to steer how visual embeddings are mapped into a task-specific state space, selectively preserving information relevant to the current task while suppressing task-irrelevant variations. Action-conditioned dynamics are then learned in this task-specific state space for planning. We evaluate ConfigWM in environments with increasing levels of distraction. While existing methods exhibit substantial declines in planning success rate as the environments become increasingly noisy, ConfigWM remains comparatively stable and outperforms the strongest competing method by 22.3% on average across diverse environments. Consistent gains in physical-quantity probing (+0.365 Pearson r) and distracted-to-clean retrieval (+75.5%) further indicate that ConfigWM learns states that preserve task-relevant information while remaining robust to distractors, supporting reliable world modeling and planning in noisy worlds. Project Page: https://configwm.github.io

analysis.key_results: 在不同干扰程度的环境中，ConfigWM相比最强竞争方法在规划成功率上平均提升22.3%，物理量探测Pearson相关系数提升+0.365，干扰到干净检索性能提升+75.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ConfigWM，一种利用任务语言描述作为配置信号、自适应提取与任务相关状态表示的视觉世界模型，实现对干扰信息的抑制。
analysis.method: 使用语言描述作为配置信号，引导视觉嵌入映射到任务特定状态空间，并在此空间中学习动作条件动态模型进行规划。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ConfigWM通过任务语言描述配置感知过程，在任务特定状态空间中学习动作条件动态，以提升嘈杂环境下的规划鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦于世界模型中视觉状态提取的任务相关性，属于世界模型（WAM）相关研究，但未涉及机器人动作预测或VLA，与本站主题有部分关联。

papers.abstract: Model compression makes large language models deployable, but today's evaluation tells an incomplete story. Standard practice measures retained task performance and stops there. This misses a critical fact: compression perturbs the distributed knowledge embedded across billions of weights, and task scores alone cannot reveal which underlying abilities survive and which quietly collapse. To solve this question, we introduce ACE-Compression, an ability-centric evaluation framework. Instead of asking only "does the compressed model still answer correctly?", we ask "which of its core abilities remain intact?" Our framework probes four deployment-facing dimensions: procedural reasoning and constraint execution, knowledge grounding and truthfulness, social cognition and affective understanding, and persona fidelity and stylistic consistency. Across more than 35 compressed checkpoints from six open-weight LLMs-covering quantization and pruning-we find that compression redistributes ability profiles. Coarse, local, and surface-level signals often persist, while fine-grained, long-tail, and context-dependent abilities become fragile. Quantization consistently outperforms pruning in retention, but the practical meaning of that gap depends entirely on which ability an application requires. Based on our findings, deployers can choose compression methods by the ability profile their application needs, not just by a leaderboard average. And algorithm designers gain diagnostic signals to build compression methods that preserve what matters. We believe that ACE-Compression turns compression from a black-box accuracy drop into an interpretable intervention-one we can measure, understand, and ultimately improve.

analysis.key_results: 压缩重新分配能力分布；粗粒度、局部、表面信号常保留，而细粒度、长尾、上下文相关能力变脆弱；量化在保留能力上始终优于剪枝，但实际意义取决于应用所需能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ACE-Compression能力为中心的评估框架，揭示压缩对模型中分布式知识能力的影响，并对比量化与剪枝的能力保留差异。
analysis.method: 从四个部署维度（程序推理与约束执行、知识基础与真实性、社会认知与情感理解、人设保真与风格一致性）对超过35个压缩检查点进行探测评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ACE-Compression框架，从能力维度评估量化与剪枝压缩后大语言模型的能力保留情况。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦通用大语言模型压缩评估，未涉及VLA或机器人世界模型；但其能力导向的评估方法和量化与剪枝对比结论对机器人模型高效推理评估具有借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Endoscopic video contains state transitions induced by camera displacement, deformable tissue, and instrument interaction, yet existing pre-training methods treat dynamics implicitly. Inspired by action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive world models and by the observation that endoscopic optical flow contains both shared image-plane displacement and localized residual motion, we reformulate passive endoscopic video pre-training as causal motion-guided latent-state prediction. We present EndoWorld-JEPA, to our knowledge the first latent world-model pre-training framework designed for general-purpose endoscopic video representation learning. In place of recorded actions, calibrated poses, or robot kinematics, the model conditions prediction of the next latent state on motion observed up to the current state. Its Optical Motion-guided module separates dominant displacement from residual motion and converts the resulting evidence into an ordered temporal motion condition and spatial local-motion weights. Complementary global and motion-local predictors use these outputs: the temporal condition modulates both latent transitions, whereas the local weights define an auxiliary motion-local state that extends prediction from scene-level evolution to spatially selective dynamics. Patch-wise motion weighting emphasizes localized change while retaining anatomical context, and past-motion-window dropout randomly withholds the complete motion condition to reduce dependence on unreliable motion. This global--local formulation learns predictable visual--motion dynamics in representation space without reconstructing stochastic appearance artifacts. Evaluation shows that a common pre-trained checkpoint achieves strong transfer across four downstream benchmarks, supporting motion-guided global--local latent prediction as an effective pre-training paradigm for endoscopic video.

analysis.key_results: 在四个下游基准上取得强大的迁移性能，表明运动引导的全局-局部潜在预测是有效的内窥镜视频预训练范式。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 EndoWorld-JEPA，一个运动引导的全局-局部潜在世界模型预训练框架，用于通用内窥镜视频表示学习。
analysis.method: 使用基于光学流的运动引导模块分离主导位移与残余运动，构造时间运动条件和空间局部运动权重，组合全局与运动局部预测器进行下一潜在状态预测；采用补丁级运动加权和过去运动窗口随机丢弃。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个内窥镜视频潜在世界模型预训练框架，通过运动引导的全局-局部潜在状态预测学习可迁移的表示。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文提出一种面向内窥镜视频的潜在世界模型预训练方法，利用运动条件预测潜在状态，与世界模型核心思想相关。其方法可迁移到机器人手术或内窥镜导航等序贯决策场景，但未直接涉及视觉-语言-动作模型或显式动作预测，与本站VLA/WAM主题为相邻的方法学借鉴关系。

figures.caption: Comparison of three pre-training paradigms and their treatment of local dynamics. (A) Existing endoscopic video pre-training captures temporal context, but transitions remain implicit: invariance may attenuate change, masking models transitions indirectly, and observed motion does not condition prediction. (B) Medical world models rely on domain-specific data and transition conditions unavailable in passive endoscopy. (C) EndoWorld-JEPA couples an Optical Motion-guided (OM) block that derives motion guidance from unlabeled passive video with a causal global–local JEPA, requiring no recorded controls or calibrated poses. Bottom: a schematic comparison illustrates that existing video pre-training models localized dynamics only implicitly within global latent features, whereas the OM block produces an explicit local-motion map whose patch weighting emphasizes motion-relevant regions.

papers.abstract: This paper shows that JEPA-style latent world models (LWMs) can learn across diverse domains and data sources by adopting the language-conditioned interface of video generation models. We establish this approach as an effective and efficient basis for planning with imagination and downstream policy fine-tuning. To this end, we introduce LaLa-World, a Language-conditioned Latent World model that learns from simulation and robot trajectories together with broader image and video data. Two designs make this work. First, we describe both numerical actions and visual changes in language, enabling joint training of a single future predictor across heterogeneous datasets. Second, we build the predictor on a language model, allowing it to interpret language conditions while predicting future latent states. The resulting predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than existing LWMs trained separately for each domain or task. Adding image and video data further improves average planning performance and robustness to action phrasing. In a matched comparison with an RAEv2-based video generation model baseline, LaLa-World reaches comparable planning performance with $6\times$ less training cost and $13.9\times$ faster planning. Beyond planning, the pretrained LaLa-World serves as an initialization for LaLa-Policy, which jointly predicts actions and future visual representations. LaLa-Policy performs competitively with Cosmos Policy on LIBERO and RoboCasa, with up to $5.5\times$ faster inference.

analysis.key_results: 平均MPC规划性能超越以往分域训练的LWM；加入图像视频数据进一步提升规划性能和鲁棒性；与RAEv2视频生成模型相比，在相当性能下训练成本降低6倍，规划速度提升13.9倍；LaLa-Policy在LIBERO和RoboCasa上性能与Cosmos Policy相当，推理速度最高提升5.5倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LaLa-World，一个利用自然语言统一动作与视觉变化、跨异构数据训练的语言条件潜在世界模型，并展示其在规划和策略学习上的效果。
analysis.method: 通过语言描述数值动作和视觉变化，基于语言模型构建未来预测器，联合训练仿真、机器人轨迹及图像视频数据，并用于MPC规划和策略初始化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出语言条件潜在世界模型LaLa-World，统一仿真与机器人数据，实现高效规划及策略微调。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文核心贡献为语言条件潜在世界模型，属于世界模型（WAM）范畴；其下游策略LaLa-Policy直接处理机器人动作预测，并与机器人策略基准对比，因此与VLA/WAM高度相关，且通过联合预测动作与未来视觉表示提升机器人学习效率。

(b) A single predictor built on a language model uses encoded observations and language conditions to predict future visual representations. Fine-tuning the pretrained LaLa-World yields LaLa-Policy, which predicts actions as well as future visual representations. (c) The jointly trained predictor achieves higher average MPC planning performance than both separately trained LWM baselines and the generative world model baseline, RAEv2. papers.abstract: Multimodal reasoning provides robotic foundation models with predictive context needed for reliable action generation. However, language-based reasoning captures task semantics but struggles to express fine-grained physical dynamics, while latent reasoning models future state evolution but offers limited structure for organizing these dynamics into reusable reasoning primitives. To bridge this gap, we introduce PhysWord, a reasoning-before-acting foundation model built on Physical Words, which use atomic action verbs as shared semantic anchors for continuous representations of physical dynamics. Specifically, PhysWord predicts upcoming atomic action words and directly aligns their contextual hidden states with latent targets derived from the corresponding future observations. Building on these primitives, we construct a temporally structured PhysWord space with visual and optional tactile variants of each action word. Autoregressively predicting Physical Words across future timesteps captures transitions between execution stages, providing structured multimodal context for action generation. PhysWord achieves state-of-the-art success rates of 90.3\% on visuotactile UniVTAC and 99.6\% on vision-based LIBERO-Long, and outperforms competing methods on real-world tasks using bimanual grippers and dexterous hands. Further evaluations demonstrate that our structured latent reasoning framework generalizes to unseen scenarios and enables long-horizon manipulation. Project page: https://nvidia-isaac.github.io/video_to_data/physicalword/

analysis.key_results: 在UniVTAC上达到90.3%成功率，在LIBERO-Long上达到99.6%成功率，并在双臂夹爪和灵巧手的真实任务中优于现有方法。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PhysWord模型，通过预测原子动作词并将其隐状态与未来观测的潜在表征对齐，构建具有时间结构的物理词空间，为动作生成提供结构化上下文。
analysis.method: PhysWord使用原子动作词作为语义锚点，对连续物理动态表示进行对齐；自回归预测未来时间步的物理词，捕捉动作阶段过渡，并支持视觉和触觉两种形式的物理词变体。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种名为PhysWord的推理后行动基础模型，通过以原子动作词为语义锚点的“物理词”来结构化多模态潜在推理，从而提升机器人操作性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接属于VLA范畴，提出一种结合语言锚点与潜在推理的机器人基础模型，用于改善动作生成，并展示在仿真和真实机器人操作任务上的优越性能，与本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: PhysWord framework. (a) PhysWord connects temporal perception and reasoning-and-action branches through shared attention in a MoT architecture, generating Physical Words autoregressively before denoising actions. (b) The hidden states of visual and tactile Physical Word variants receive joint action-label cross-entropy supervision and cosine alignment with future sensory latent targets. (c) Physical Words use a blockwise-causal attention mask, with full attention within each end-effector’s timestep block, causal attention across its blocks, and no cross-effector attention.

papers.abstract: Every driving scene is logged once, but driving is one-to-many: the scene determines which behaviors are feasible, while an instruction selects among them. A log records only the action taken, leaving no direct supervision for alternative feasible actions or instructions the scene cannot support. Consequently, a policy that ignores language and one that follows it without regard to scene constraints can fit the same data. We present Cartender, which learns from the drives not taken. Counterfactual Branching constructs matched and mismatched instruction-action pairs from real recordings without a simulator: a vision-language model proposes alternative futures and their selecting instructions, while unsupported instructions provide negative labels. A learned scene-language compatibility score regulates language conditioning in trajectory generation, and a reward-trained language residual re-ranks generated candidates over a scene-based score. The branches are used for training; instruction following is evaluated by swapping instructions under identical recorded inputs and measuring behavior rather than agreement with generated targets. On WOD-E2E, the best of four proposals achieves an RFS of 8.642 across 3,603 feasible instruction conditions. Across 8,974 admitted proposals, mean RFS is 8.203 versus 7.906 for matched logged trajectories, and 67% score higher than their logged counterpart. Compared with matched-only imitation using the same backbone, Cartender improves same-scene paired instruction success from 23.67% to 57.00% and RFS from 6.32 to 7.10; its gate reduces infeasible-instruction execution from 53.36% to 14.18%.

analysis.key_results: 在WOD-E2E上，四个提案中最佳RFS为8.642（3603个可行指令条件）；89874个已接收提案平均RFS为8.203对比匹配记录轨迹的7.906；67%得分高于记录轨迹；同场景配对指令成功率从23.67%提升至57.00%，RFS从6.32提升至7.10；不可行指令执行率从53.36%降至14.18%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Cartender方法，通过反事实分支从真实驾驶记录中学习未采取的驾驶行为，并引入场景-语言兼容性分数调节语言条件轨迹生成，以及奖励训练的语言残差重排序生成候选。
analysis.method: 使用视觉-语言模型提议替代未来及其选择指令，从不支持的指令获取负标签；训练场景-语言兼容性分数调节语言条件轨迹生成；利用奖励训练的语言残差在基于场景的分数上重排序候选。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Cartender利用真实驾驶记录中的反事实分支生成匹配与不匹配的指令-动作对，以学习场景-语言兼容性并提升语言条件驾驶策略的指令遵循能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文涉及语言条件驾驶策略的学习与评估，属于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）驱动的机器人学习方向，但未明确涉及世界模型（WAM），与本站主题部分相关。

papers.abstract: Embodied VLMs can execute increasingly complex manipulation tasks, yet execution errors can leave the environment in states that require replanning for recovery. Existing recovery methods either rely on inference-time mechanisms with fixed policies or learn from failure examples and reference corrections rather than verified action outcomes. To enable recovery learning through verifiable interaction, we introduce the Embodied Replanning for Recovery Environment (ERR-Env), which provides feedback on task progress and execution errors. We further construct ERR-Bench, a benchmark with held-out tasks spanning nominal, intermediate, and error states for evaluating recovery capability and execution reliability. We then propose Action-Grouped Turn-GSPO (AGT-GSPO), an online reinforcement learning method combining turn-level rewards for task progress and error states with action-grouped advantage estimation, and use it to train ERR-VLM, a compact 2B embodied VLM. Evaluation on ERR-Bench reveals a mismatch between task progress and execution reliability across diverse VLMs. AGT-GSPO improves ERR-VLM by 10.25 percentage points in Strict Success Rate for error-free completion and 22.95 percentage points in Recovery Rate, while ablations and zero-shot transfer further validate the effectiveness of our method.

analysis.key_results: ERR-VLM在Strict Success Rate上提升10.25个百分点，在Recovery Rate上提升22.95个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了用于可验证错误恢复学习的ERR-Env环境和ERR-Bench基准，以及在线强化学习方法AGT-GSPO，训练出2B参数的ERR-VLM，在严格成功率和恢复率上取得显著提升。
analysis.method: 在线强化学习方法Action-Grouped Turn-GSPO (AGT-GSPO)，结合turn级任务进度与错误状态奖励和动作分组优势估计。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ERR-Env、ERR-Bench和AGT-GSPO方法，通过可验证交互训练紧凑的2B具身VLM，显著提升错误恢复能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是训练具身视觉语言模型（VLA）进行错误恢复，与本站主题VLA直接相关，但不涉及世界模型或高效推理方法。

papers.abstract: Fast and reliable manipulation is crucial for practical robot deployment. Although Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently shown remarkable progress as generalist robot policies, their execution often remains temporally inefficient. A key source of this inefficiency is that policies learn fine-grained temporal patterns from teleoperated demonstrations, requiring many low-level action steps. Temporal action quantization offers a simple way to accelerate execution by aggregating consecutive low-level actions into temporally coarser actions. However, applying action quantization without considering when fine-grained control is required introduces a speed-accuracy trade-off: accelerated actions may efficiently reduce redundant steps in some phases, while discarding critical motion details in precision-sensitive interactions. To address this, we propose PaceVLA, a unified framework for adaptive temporal execution in VLAs that integrates two coupled components: (1) mode-specific action decoders built on a shared action expert, supporting multiple temporal granularities and prediction horizons, and (2) a quantizability-guided mode selection scheme which decides whether coarse execution is appropriate, and a context-conditioned router that selects an execution mode at each inference step. Experiments across three multi-task simulation benchmarks and six real-world tasks show that PaceVLA improves execution efficiency while maintaining task success rate across multiple embodiments, including long-horizon and dexterous manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在三个多任务仿真基准和六个真实世界任务中，PaceVLA 在多种机器人本体上提升执行效率并保持任务成功率，包括长程和灵巧操作任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PaceVLA 统一框架，集成模式特定动作解码器和可量化性引导的模式选择方案，实现 VLA 模型中的自适应时序动作量化。
analysis.method: 共享动作专家上的模式特定动作解码器，支持多种时间粒度和预测范围；可量化性引导的模式选择方案和上下文条件路由器在每个推理步骤选择执行模式。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PaceVLA 提出一种自适应时序动作量化框架，通过模式特定解码器与可量化性引导的模式选择，在保持成功率的同时提升 VLA 机器人策略的执行效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 模型的执行效率问题，提出时序动作量化方法，属于 VLA 与模型量化/高效推理的交叉研究，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

analysis.key_results: 在Simpler-WidowX上从58.7%提升至69.8%（+11.1个百分点），LIBERO上达到97.2%，真实世界任务达到52.8%，RMBench记忆依赖任务为21.6%。
analysis.limitations: 在较难的依赖多观测的任务上暴露有限历史窗口的局限性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CondenseVLA，一种多帧VLA策略，在解码端引入可学习历史压缩模块，将历史观测压缩为有限槽令牌，并通过辅助正则化减少槽冗余、鼓励互补注意力。
analysis.method: 使用可学习查询和多头交叉注意力将缓存的逐帧特征压缩为固定数量的槽令牌；通过惩罚槽注意力图重叠和去相关槽嵌入的正则化减少冗余。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CondenseVLA提出在VLA解码端增加可学习历史压缩模块，将多帧视觉特征压缩为固定槽令牌，以高效利用短期视觉上下文进行动作预测。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA的高效历史推理进行优化，通过压缩历史视觉特征降低计算开销，与视觉-语言-动作模型及高效推理主题高度相关。

The left panel highlights history-dependent failures of single-step VLA execution: in Pick and Place Twice, the policy forgets which plate to place next; in Swap Cubes, it forgets which cube should be picked next. Across multiple benchmarks, including Simpler, LIBERO, and real-world robot experiments, CondenseVLA consistently outperforms the CronusVLA baseline.

papers.abstract: Visual world models have shown strong potential for robot planning, yet long-horizon manipulation remains challenging due to compounding prediction errors, large search complexity, and latent plans that the low-level controller cannot reliably reach. In this work, we introduce Vector-Quantized World Model (VQ-WM), a latent feedback motion planning framework that integrates discrete long-horizon search with continuous visual feedback control: a discrete latent predictor models transitions between vector-quantized latent states, allowing the planner to look far ahead and find a shortest path to the goal through discrete search and a continuous learned controller sequentially reaches the planned states through visual feedback, correcting deviations to mitigate compounding errors. Whereas most vector quantization uses Euclidean distance, we use a novel estimator of the first-passage-time as a quasi-metric, which aligns the planning abstraction with the controller's capabilities. We evaluate on the physical robot manipulation of the Tower of Hanoi puzzle: whereas existing state-of-the-art foundation models (VLAs, WAMs) only succeed when the solution trace in their training dataset, our method achieves 100\% success rate with only short-play data, demonstrate its ability to compose long-horizon solutions beyond the short demonstrated trajectories and execute them reliably. Our solution also outperforms strongest world-models by 13.3--85.3 percentage points on simulation benchmarks spanning manipulation and locomotion, demonstrating consistent progress and new capabilities.

analysis.key_results: 在物理机器人河内塔操作中达到100%成功率；在仿真基准上比最强世界模型高出13.3-85.3个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入向量量化世界模型（VQ-WM）框架，通过离散潜在预测器和连续视觉反馈控制器，实现长时程操作任务的高成功率与强泛化能力。
analysis.method: 离散潜在预测器基于向量量化潜在状态建模转移，规划器通过离散搜索寻找最短路径，连续学习控制器通过视觉反馈依次到达计划状态；采用首次通过时间估计器作为拟度量。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出向量量化世界模型（VQ-WM），结合离散长时程搜索与连续视觉反馈控制，实现机器人操作的长时程规划与执行。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉世界模型（WAM）在机器人操作中的长时程规划问题，与VLA/WAM主题高度相关。论文展示了VQ-WM相对于现有VLA和WAM方法的优势，特别是在仅使用短时演示数据时能组合出超出训练分布的长时程解决方案。

figures.caption: Overview of VQ-WM. The initial (green) and goal (red) images are encoded into latent states and vector-quantized according to controller reachability, so that each vector-quantized state serves as a target the controller is expected to reach. The planner performs discrete search over these vector-quantized states using a discrete latent predictor. A continuous controller then drives the robot toward each planned target in turn, using visual feedback to correct deviations along the way.

(b) Offline training learns the controller and continuous latent predictor, performs state vector quantization using first-passage time, and then learns vector-quantized latent dynamics.

papers.title: Vector-Quantized World Model: Latent Feedback Motion Planning for Robot Manipulation

papers.abstract: General purpose multimodal language models (LMs) are increasingly capable of directly controlling robotic arms (e.g., by commanding end effector poses) to manipulate their environment. Tracking the development of these capabilities is important for understanding their potential benefits, such as improving industrial automation, and risks, such as enabling malicious users to produce dangerous chemical or biological agents. To this end, we investigate the ability of frontier multimodal LMs to directly control physical robotic arms. We evaluate nine models at multiple reasoning-effort and service-tier settings on six manipulation tasks taken from the RoboDojo benchmark. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic comparison of a broad range of frontier LMs across a common suite of manipulation tasks on physical hardware. We find that current frontier models can directly control real robotic arms to perform a variety of manipulation tasks but are not yet precise or efficient enough to complete them within a practical action budget. However, these capabilities are improving rapidly: performance increases on our benchmark between July and October 2026 (inclusive) correspond to a performance doubling time of 53.9 days, while the best recorded execution rate increased by a factor of 4.4 and the lowest recorded execution cost fell by a factor of 6.2. These trends raise the possibility that the Bitter Lesson is coming to robotics; the capabilities of embodied general purpose LMs may one day be comparable to those of more specialized models.

analysis.key_results: 当前模型能直接控制真实机械臂但精度和效率不足；2026年7月至10月性能翻倍时间为53.9天，最佳执行速率增长4.4倍，最低执行成本下降6.2倍。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究首次系统评估了前沿多模态语言模型直接控制真实机械臂执行操作任务的能力与效率。

papers.abstract: Flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) models generate an action chunk by iteratively denoising Gaussian noise, but typically execute only a short prefix before replanning with updated observations. Under this receding-horizon paradigm, the unexecuted remainder---the action tail---is discarded, and the next chunk is regenerated from fresh noise. We show that this discarded tail retains transferable denoising progress: action-tail initialization can match or outperform a native 10-step Gaussian baseline using fewer denoising steps. However, the optimal denoising budget varies substantially across samples, indicating that tail reuse should be adapted to the updated environment. Based on this observation, we introduce VLA-Rolling, a lightweight inference framework that reuses action tails through three stages: action-tail inheritance, per-action confidence estimation, and confidence-guided refinement through renoising and denoising budget allocation, while the underlying VLA remains frozen. Across $\pi_{0.5}$, SmolVLA, X-VLA, and MolmoAct2 on LIBERO, MetaWorld, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin 2.0, VLA-Rolling reduces action-chunk inference cost in all 16 model--benchmark pairs, achieving up to a $1.48\times$ speedup, while improving success rate in 14 pairs by up to $15.08$ percentage points. These results show that action tails are not merely discarded predictions, but reusable intermediate states that enable more efficient and accurate VLA inference. These results demonstrate that the action tail can support the generation of better actions with fewer denoising steps. Our project is available at https://chenbao123ww.github.io/VLA-Rolling/.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、MetaWorld、LIBERO-Plus和RoboTwin 2.0基准上，对π0.5、SmolVLA、X-VLA和MolmoAct2共16个模型-基准组合进行评估，VLA-Rolling在所有组合中降低了动作块推理成本，最高加速1.48倍，并在14个组合中提升了成功率，最高提升15.08个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 发现动作尾部保留了可迁移的去噪进度，并设计VLA-Rolling框架，通过动作尾部继承、置信度估计和置信引导的细化，在冻结VLA模型的情况下降低推理成本并提升成功率。
analysis.method: VLA-Rolling推理框架，包含三个阶段：动作尾部继承、逐动作置信度估计、通过重噪声和去噪预算分配的置信引导细化；在滑动时域执行中重用未被执行的去噪动作尾部。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一个轻量级推理框架VLA-Rolling，通过重用被丢弃的动作尾部并自适应分配去噪预算，在多种VLA模型和机器人基准上实现了更高效和更准确的动作生成。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的推理加速，属于VLA高效推理的核心主题。它不涉及世界模型或WAM，但通过重用去噪过程中的动作尾部并自适应分配计算预算，为机器人策略的实时执行提供了实用且广泛适用的优化方法。

papers.abstract: We introduce Muse Glimmer, an open-source 30B parameter causal language model with perception encoder, purpose-built for autonomous agentic tasks on consumer hardware. Muse Glimmer integrates multi-step reasoning, reliable tool use and failure recovery into a single model that runs locally on consumer devices without requiring cloud infrastructure. The model accepts text and image inputs and produces text outputs, was trained on data from over a hundred languages, and is quantized to approximately 4-bit precision for efficient single-GPU inference. Muse Glimmer achieves state-of-the-art performance for its size class on agentic benchmarks, setting a new standard compared to the models of its size: Gemma4-31B and Qwen3.6-27B on tool use, multi-step planning, and agentic task completion. We release the model under the Apache 2.0 license to foster open-source development of capable, safe, local AI agents.

analysis.key_results: 在同规模模型中（Gemma4-31B、Qwen3.6-27B）在工具使用、多步规划和智能体任务完成上取得最先进性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并开源Muse Glimmer 30B模型，以约4-bit量化实现单GPU高效推理，在工具使用、多步规划和智能体任务完成等基准上达到同规模最优。
analysis.method: 训练一个带感知编码器的30B因果语言模型，接受文本和图像输入，集成多步推理、可靠工具使用和失败恢复，并量化为约4-bit精度以支持本地部署。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入开源30B参数因果语言模型Muse Glimmer，集成感知编码器、4-bit量化与多步推理、工具使用和失败恢复能力，面向消费级硬件上的自主智能体任务。

papers.abstract: Reverse target fishing identifies protein targets for a query molecule and is central to drug discovery and repurposing. Discriminative approaches adapted from virtual screening face sparse, long-tailed associations and missing-not-at-random measurements: treating unrecorded pairs as negatives can suppress genuine targets. We reformulate the task as generative retrieval and introduce GenFish. Residual vector quantization converts frozen protein language model features into shared semantic identifiers. Given a molecular fingerprint, GenFish autoregressively models codes conditioned on the query and preceding code, ranking proteins by identifier likelihood without explicitly labeling unrecorded pairs as negatives. We introduce ProTargetBench, the first proteome-scale benchmark for reverse target fishing to jointly support measured-panel discrimination and full-catalogue recovery of experimentally recorded positives. Covering 20,431 UniProt-reviewed human proteins, it integrates curated bioactivity evidence and distinguishes experimental inactivity from unmeasured associations. On 198 held-out molecules, GenFish achieves higher mean performance across all three full-catalogue retrieval metrics than four discriminative neural baselines and three non-neural baselines, including ligand-based methods. A controlled positive-hiding experiment shows that targeted removal of false-negative competition improves contrastive retrieval beyond matched random masking; GenFish remains stronger under the same incomplete supervision. Pfam alignment indicates that the semantic identifiers capture biologically meaningful relationships among proteins. These results establish generative retrieval as a principled paradigm for reverse target fishing under incomplete bioactivity records.

analysis.key_results: 在198个保留分子上，GenFish在全部三个全目录检索指标上平均性能优于四个判别式神经基线和三个非神经基线；阳性隐藏实验表明其方法在相同不完全监督下更强；Pfam比对显示语义标识符捕获了生物学上有意义的蛋白质关系。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GenFish生成式检索方法，并构建首个蛋白质组尺度的逆向靶点发现基准ProTargetBench。
analysis.method: 利用残差向量量化将蛋白质语言模型特征转换为共享语义标识符，以分子指纹为条件自回归建模标识码，基于似然排序蛋白质。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出一种基于残差向量量化的生成式检索方法GenFish，用于在蛋白质组尺度进行逆向靶点发现，并构建了首个相关基准ProTargetBench。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文核心是向量量化在蛋白质检索任务中的应用，与机器人视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Location encoders learn compact representations of latitude--longitude coordinates for downstream geospatial prediction tasks. Existing approaches are pretrained using continuous or naturally occurring supervision, such as imagery, climate variables, or species distributions, and therefore do not explicitly capture administrative boundaries or place names, despite their strong influence on many real-world geospatial phenomena. We introduce, to our knowledge, the first method for learning administrative boundary-aware location encoders, using reverse-geocoded text as a self-supervised training signal. Our approach can be applied to existing location encoder architectures and consistently improves their downstream performance. We further introduce RevGeoRQ, a custom architecture tailored to reverse-geocoding supervision, which yields additional gains and exceeds contemporary location encoders on several downstream tasks. Finally, the use of human-interpretable reverse-geocoded strings and residual-quantized semantic IDs provides a more interpretable representation of geographic location than existing approaches. Code and model weights to be released soon.

analysis.key_results: 方法在多个下游任务上一致提升现有位置编码器性能，且RevGeoRQ进一步超越当代位置编码器。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并设计了RevGeoRQ架构，同时使用残差量化语义ID提供可解释的地理表示。
analysis.method: 使用反向地理编码文本作为自监督训练信号，应用于现有位置编码器架构；提出RevGeoRQ自定义架构，采用残差量化语义ID表示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出利用反向地理编码文本作为自监督信号来学习行政区划感知的位置编码器，并引入RevGeoRQ架构及残差量化语义ID表示。

papers.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, gives the agent a thin harness: one command line that turns its commands into robot motion and makes no decisions of its own. On the robot, the agent keeps doing what it does best: it reads output, writes code and runs tests. Two agents of the same model share the work. An acting agent runs each episode. After a failure, an optimizer agent reads the full record of the episode, with every command, image and message, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools, each with its own tests. What the agents learn stays as code, and no demonstrations or training are needed. At run time, the tools use only what a real robot also has: RGB images, camera calibration and the state of the arms. They find objects by triangulation between camera views. Because these inputs are the same in simulation and on hardware, the tools move to a real robot with a different arm after only a small change for the arm. We build the tools on ten layouts of one seed per task with Codex and GPT-6-Astra and freeze them; the eight Open tasks share one set of tools. In RoboDojo's official evaluation on a hidden seed, 50 episodes for each of the 42 tasks, HexaShell reaches 46.9% success and a progress score of 53.2, the state of the art on the official RoboDojo leaderboard. The limit is contact, not reasoning: memory tasks reach 81.0%, but precision tasks only 32.0%. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo官方评测中，42个任务各50轮，达到46.9%成功率和53.2进度分，为官方排行榜最优；记忆类任务成功率81.0%，精密类任务仅32.0%。
analysis.limitations: 性能瓶颈在接触操作而非推理；精密操作任务成功率较低（32.0%）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出HexaShell，一个将VLM转用于机器人控制的薄型接口，通过让代理编写代码工具实现跨仿真到真机的泛化，并在RoboDojo基准上取得最优成绩。
analysis.method: 使用两个VLM代理分工：一个执行，一个优化；代理通过命令行接口控制机器人，通过三角测量定位物体，并编写带测试的工具；工具在仿真和硬件上共享，迁移到不同机械臂只需小改。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出HexaShell，一个薄型接口，让VLM代理直接控制机器人并通过角色分工和工具学习在仿真与真实间迁移，在RoboDojo排行榜上取得最优成绩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接面向VLA（视觉-语言-动作）智能体在真实机器人操作中的应用，提出以代码作为策略表示的新方法；虽然不显式构建世界模型或动作世界模型，但其工具学习和跨仿真-真实迁移的方法对机器人学习策略有直接价值，可视为一种替代传统VLA行为克隆的途径。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models can learn a wide range of robotic skills, but combining separately trained skills remains challenging. The original training data may be unavailable for joint retraining, while directly merging model weights can cause interference. We propose NestedVLA, which consolidates independently fine-tuned VLA policies without access to their original training data. Instead of merging all updates into one checkpoint, a hypernetwork embedded in the VLA generates action-expert weight updates for a selected task. Each task's compressed vision-language model update is stored separately, and both updates are added to a frozen base VLA to instantiate the corresponding policy. We evaluate NestedVLA by consolidating three policies fine-tuned with reinforcement learning on MetaWorld, ManiSkill, and CALVIN. It achieves 66.7% average success, improving on the strongest model-merging baseline by 41.1 percentage points. It performs within 1 percentage point of per-task fine-tuning on ManiSkill and substantially narrows the gap on CALVIN. In this three-policy setting, total storage is 1.5x that of a single full checkpoint. Code is available at https://github.com/WanyuGroup/NeurIPS2026-NestedVLA.

analysis.key_results: 在MetaWorld、ManiSkill和CALVIN上整合三个强化学习微调策略，平均成功率66.7%，比最强模型合并基线提高41.1个百分点；在ManiSkill上性能与单任务微调相差1个百分点以内，在CALVIN上大幅缩小差距；三策略设置下总存储是单个完整检查点的1.5倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出NestedVLA，一种无需原始训练数据即可整合独立微调VLA策略的方法，通过超网络为选定任务生成动作专家更新，并将压缩的视觉-语言模型更新分开存储。
analysis.method: 在冻结的基础VLA上嵌入超网络，为选定任务生成动作专家权重更新；每个任务的压缩VLM更新单独存储，并与基础模型相结合实现策略实例化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: NestedVLA通过超网络生成动作专家权重更新，将独立微调的VLA策略整合到一个框架中，无需访问原始训练数据。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接聚焦VLA模型，解决多技能策略整合问题，核心贡献在于无需原始数据的技能融合与生成机制，对VLA在机器人技能学习中的实用化有直接价值。

(b) NestedVLA retains a compressed task-specific VLM update and uses an embedded task-conditioned hypernetwork to generate the action-expert update. Both updates are applied to a shared base to materialize the selected VLA.

figures.caption: NestedVLA pipeline. (1) Skill acquisition : each task is fine-tuned independently from the same base Θ 0 \Theta_{0} and the resulting task vector τ m \tau_{m} is compressed into a sparse skill z m = α ⋅ τ m ⊙ M m z_{m}=\alpha\cdot\tau_{m}\odot M_{m} via drop-and-rescale. (2) Skill consolidation : a single nested hypernetwork 𝒢 ϕ \mathcal{G}_{\phi} is trained against the action-expert portions of { z m } \{z_{m}\} with a multi-task masked MSE loss. (3) Skill generation : at inference, querying 𝒢 ϕ \mathcal{G}_{\phi} with task id m m generates the action-expert update; the corresponding compressed VLM update is retrieved and both compose with the frozen base.

papers.abstract: We introduce P$^{3}$-WAM, a unified world action model for egocentric dexterous manipulation that learns 3D perception, action-conditioned prediction, and goal-directed planning through three complementary modes: Perceive, which reconstructs articulated hand motion and camera trajectories from video; Predict, which generates visual futures under prescribed actions; and Plan, which jointly generates action trajectories and their anticipated visual consequences conditioned on an initial image, a language instruction, and an optional visual goal. Our model integrates a compact, structured 3D action representation into a pretrained video diffusion transformer through a mixture-of-transformers architecture with shared base weights, modality-specific adaptation, and bidirectional visual-action attention. Randomized modality visibility lets video and 3D actions serve as either conditioning context or prediction targets across the three modes. Experiments show that unified training improves all three capabilities over single-mode training, including gains in planning quality under a vision-language model evaluation. Through unified training, our model outperforms specialized baselines on 3D hand reconstruction and action-conditioned video prediction across four datasets, while producing goal-directed manipulation videos with stronger instruction adherence and action progression than video-generation baselines. Project Page: https://p3-wam.pages.dev/

analysis.key_results: 统一训练相比单模态训练在所有三种能力上均有提升，包括在视觉语言模型评估下规划质量的提高；在3D手部重建和动作条件视频预测方面优于专门基线，并生成具有更强指令遵循性和动作进展的目标导向操作视频。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了P³-WAM，一个统一的世界行动模型，将紧凑的3D动作表示集成到预训练视频扩散Transformer中，通过混合Transformer架构、随机模态可见性和共享权重，在四种数据集上同时提升感知、预测和规划能力。
analysis.method: 采用混合Transformer架构，共享基础权重并进行模态特定适配，使用双向视觉-动作注意力；通过随机化模态可见性，使视频和3D动作可作为条件或预测目标，在感知、预测、规划三种模式下联合训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了P³-WAM，一个统一的自我中心灵巧操作世界行动模型，通过感知、预测和规划三种模式联合学习3D感知、动作条件预测与目标导向规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接相关：该工作属于世界行动模型（WAM），面向机器人操作，联合学习3D感知、动作预测与目标导向规划，并针对自我中心灵巧操作场景，对VLA/WAM领域具有核心研究价值。

papers.abstract: Real-time interaction requires agents to perceive evolving environments and act under temporal constraints, yet existing evaluations of real-time streaming models focus on conversational quality and streaming perception, leaving effective action under strict temporal constraints untested. We introduce Realtime-Bench, a suite of carefully curated dynamic tasks where delayed actions directly affect success. Under Wall Clock, where environments advance according to actual inference latency, the best success rate reaches only 44% and the best Pass^3 is only 36%, demonstrating that real-time interaction remains challenging. To separate serving latency from models' real-time streaming capability, we compare Wall Clock with Paused Clock, which removes inference delays as an idealized reference, and introduce Token Clock, which advances simulated time according to generated token counts, testing temporal awareness independently of physical serving speed. We find that temporal costs limit success in evolving environments and that higher reasoning effort has mixed effects under time pressure, reflecting a trade-off between decision quality and timely execution. Based on these results, we discuss future directions for improving real-time multimodal models, including adaptive reasoning with temporal awareness and continuous perception and action.

analysis.key_results: 在Wall Clock下最佳成功率为44%，最佳Pass^3为36%；时间成本限制成功，更高推理努力在时间压力下效果参半。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Realtime-Bench基准，包含动态任务和三套时钟机制（Wall Clock、Paused Clock、Token Clock）用于评估实时交互能力。
analysis.method: 设计动态任务，分别使用Wall Clock、Paused Clock和Token Clock三种时钟模式控制环境推进，以区分延迟、模型推理能力和时间感知能力。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出Realtime-Bench基准，评估实时多模态模型在严格时间约束下采取有效行动的能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作评估通用多模态模型在实时交互场景下的行动能力，虽非针对机器人VLA或世界模型，但其时间约束下行动评估的方法对机器人实时决策研究具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Exact $k$-nearest-neighbor (kNN) search over image descriptors and embeddings underlies visual retrieval, near-duplicate detection, the evaluation of learned representations, and increasingly the memory of LLM agents. However, exhaustive search computes every distance at full precision, whereas approximate indexes return recall below one. We observe that exact search only needs a proof that each excluded vector cannot be a neighbor. Because such a proof only has to be conservative, it can be checked in low precision, much as the retina examines the whole scene at low resolution. We call this principle certified exclusion and realize it in an exact kNN method for GPUs, which we call CertEx. Specifically, CertEx stores a lower-bounding projection of each vector in half precision and folds a rounding certificate into the same tensor-core dot product, so that only the few vectors that the test keeps need exact distances. We prove that CertEx returns the exact kNN of every query. On sixteen datasets with up to 100M vectors, CertEx is exact for every query at 7.1$\times$ to 18.0$\times$ the throughput of the fastest cuVS search on one H100 (8.8$\times$ to 11.8$\times$ on an A100) and outperforms quantized and graph indexes whenever every query must be exact.

analysis.key_results: 在 16 个数据集（最大 1 亿向量）上，CertEx 对所有查询均精确，吞吐量是 H100 上最快 cuVS 的 7.1 倍至 18.0 倍（A100 上为 8.8 倍至 11.8 倍），并在所有查询必须精确时优于量化索引和图索引。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出认证排除（certified exclusion）原则，并在 GPU 上实现精确 kNN 方法 CertEx，保证查询精确性的同时大幅提升检索速度。
analysis.method: 将每个向量的下界投影以半精度存储，并在同一个张量核心点积中融入舍入证书，仅对通过测试的少数向量计算精确距离。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CertEx 通过认证排除机制，在 GPU 上半精度存储下界投影并利用张量核心点积实现大规模精确 kNN 检索，显著提升吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大规模图像描述符和嵌入的精确 kNN 检索，通过低精度下界存储和认证排除来加速推理，属于模型量化与高效推理技术。该技术可潜在用于 VLA/WAM 中的嵌入索引或记忆检索，但论文未直接涉及机器人动作预测或世界模型，因此无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are expected to follow instructions like their language backbones, yet prior work has focused on What-level instructions that specify the task rather than How-level instructions that specify how to carry it out. Through our diagnoses, we find that How-level instructions do not help current VLAs and lower task success. We hypothesize that pairing each training episode with a single instruction limits How-level instruction following, and show that training with segment-level enriched instructions makes actions respond to such instructions without consistently raising task success. To measure How-level instruction following beyond standard benchmarks, we introduce SIMPLER-IN, where success requires conditions given only in the instruction. It shows that the gained responsiveness does not extend to demanding or out-of-distribution How-level instructions. How-level instruction following thus remains an open challenge.

analysis.key_results: How级指令不能提高当前VLA的任务成功率，甚至会降低成功率；分段级丰富指令训练可使动作对How级指令产生响应，但不能持续提高任务成功率，且这种响应不能泛化到苛刻或分布外的How级指令。
analysis.limitations: How级指令遵循仍是一个开放性挑战，所获得的响应能力无法扩展到要求严格或分布外的How级指令。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并系统诊断了VLA模型在How级指令遵循上的不足，并创建了新的评估基准SIMPLER-IN，用于衡量模型对How级指令的遵循能力。
analysis.method: 通过诊断实验发现当前VLA模型对How级指令不敏感，提出使用分段级丰富指令进行训练以增强对How级指令的响应，并通过SIMPLER-IN基准进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文诊断并评估了视觉-语言-动作模型在How级指令（描述如何执行任务）上的遵循能力，发现当前模型无法有效响应此类指令。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接以视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）为研究对象，专注于其指令遵循能力，特别是How级指令，对VLA的评估与训练方法改进具有重要意义。

papers.abstract: Humans interpret multimodal observations of the world and forecast how it will evolve. Recent multimodal generative systems have demonstrated similar capabilities: they can integrate multimodal context and synthesize visual outputs that depict changes in the world. To characterize this emerging trajectory, we organize model capabilities into a four-level hierarchy and discover that higher-level tasks remain relatively underexplored despite model progress. To bridge this gap, we explore model performance on multi-step world state prediction, a high-level task that requires models to forecast successive future world states from multimodal observations and diverse references. Such a task requires models to possess entangled understanding and generation capabilities, as well as extensive world knowledge to translate human action sequences, physical transformations, and abstract visual reasoning into coherent visual outputs. We introduce WorldCast, a benchmark comprising 320 manually designed cases across eight categories, and evaluate 12 representative models. The conducted experiments yield three key insights: (a) advances in frontier models are rapidly pushing the boundaries of intelligent world modeling, with the GPT-Image-2.5 System scoring 72.8 and demonstrating early-stage visual state prediction capabilities on real-world tasks; (b) WorldCast reveals substantial gaps between models: even Nano Banana Pro reaches only 42.8 and the best open-source model scores 20.1, with deficits in handling complex context, entangled references, and reasoning-heavy tasks; (c) strong generative models effectively draw on the capabilities of their underlying language models. These findings highlight the need for multimodal generative models that are capable of dynamic planning and reasoning while also being deeply unified to faithfully simulate real-world states.

analysis.key_results: GPT-Image-2.5系统得分72.8，Nano Banana Pro得分42.8，最佳开源模型得分20.1。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了WorldCast基准，包含320个手工设计案例，覆盖八个类别，并评估了12个代表性模型。
analysis.method: 通过构建四级能力层级、WorldCast基准以及人工智能评分系统，对模型在多步世界状态预测任务上的表现进行系统性评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了WorldCast基准，用于评估多模态模型在多步世界状态预测任务上的层级能力，并揭示了当前模型在此类高层任务上的性能差距。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文涉及世界模型和视觉生成能力的评估，但未直接针对机器人动作或世界-动作模型（VLA/WAM）。其基准和层级框架可为世界模型评估提供参考，但与本站的VLA/WAM主题无直接关系。

papers.abstract: We present FoveaVLA, a Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model that replaces the wrist camera with learned foveation actions. Wrist cameras provide close-up detail but restrict the view to the end-effector's surroundings. External cameras see the whole scene, but the policy receives them at low resolution, so the fine detail needed for manipulation is lost. FoveaVLA recovers this detail by predicting, alongside each action chunk, the interaction region to observe at the next policy query. The policy then receives crops of these regions, taken from the original-resolution images, together with the full views. We build FoveaVLA on $\pi_{0.5}$ in two configurations, Single and Dual, using one or two external stereo cameras with full and foveal RGB and depth inputs, and post-train both on DROID with RoboInter interaction annotations. Across four real-world task suites, FoveaVLA-Single achieves 70.8% success with one external RGB-D view, and FoveaVLA-Dual achieves 77.1%, versus 52.1% for the wrist-equipped $\pi_{0.5}$. Both match the baseline on plain pick-and-place and improve success with distractors, cloth manipulation, and far-away objects.

analysis.key_results: 四个真实世界任务套件中，FoveaVLA-Single成功率70.8%，FoveaVLA-Dual成功率77.1%，腕部相机基线为52.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FoveaVLA，用学习到的注视动作替代腕部相机，在VLA中实现高效的细节感知。
analysis.method: 在π0.5基础上，预测下一步观察的交互区域，并将原分辨率裁剪的注视区域与全视图一起输入策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FoveaVLA通过预测注视区域并融合局部与原图特征，在VLA中替代腕部相机，提升操作成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接属于VLA研究，通过主动注视替代腕部相机，提升机器人操作中的视觉感知效率。

The π0.5 wrist-equipped matches it when the target is already in the wrist view, but degrades with distractors and far-away objects, where FoveaVLA’s foveal crop keeps the relevant detail in sight.

papers.abstract: We introduce WorldOracle, a benchmark specifically designed to evaluate action-conditioned world models (ACWMs) against paired real-world executions. Given the same initial observation and low-level action sequence, WorldOracle asks whether a predicted rollout reproduces what happens in the real world, including physical consequences and task-state transitions. We evaluate models along four complementary dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence. To support this evaluation, we curate real-world training and evaluation suites that cover different interaction dynamics and embodiments. The evaluation suite contains long, multi-segment episodes with both successful and failed executions, enabling evaluation across varied action outcomes and behavior distributions. Experiments on seven representative ACWMs reveal distinct model strengths and failure modes. WorldOracle provides a systematic foundation for measuring and advancing action-conditioned world modeling for manipulation. We release the datasets, evaluation code, and leaderboard: https://worldoracle-benchmark.github.io/.

analysis.key_results: 在七个代表性行动条件世界模型上的实验揭示了各模型的不同优势和失败模式。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了WorldOracle基准，用于系统评估行动条件世界模型（ACWMs）在真实操作场景下的预测性能，涵盖四个评估维度并提供数据集、评估代码和排行榜。
analysis.method: 通过给定相同初始观察和低级行动序列，比较模型预测的rollout与真实世界执行的结果，从物理状态正确性、交互空间对齐、关键交互区域保真度和多视角行动一致性四个维度进行评估。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WorldOracle是一个基准，旨在通过与真实世界执行对比来评估行动条件世界模型在操作任务中的预测准确性和多维度性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接关注行动条件世界模型（WAM）在机器人操作中的评估，与本站WAM和机器人学习主题高度相关，为WAM的发展提供了基准和系统评估工具。

(b) The policy-rollout trajectories are collected by running a policy in closed loop on a real robot. (c) For both distributions, the recorded action trajectory is replayed open loop by the ACWM, yielding a generated rollout. (d) The predicted rollout is compared with the paired real execution along four dimensions: physical state correctness, interaction spatial alignment, key interaction area fidelity, and multi-view action coherence.

(b) Physical criteria annotation: a VLM generates physical-state criteria for each outcome keyframe. papers.abstract: We introduce StartLux-Decision, decision models from 0.8B to 27B parameters that combine efficient single-pass prediction with adaptive, confidence-guided reasoning. The Instant models use bidirectional attention in full-attention layers to improve decision accuracy while keeping single-pass inference. The AutoThink models invoke explicit reasoning for uncertain decisions and answer confident cases directly. A three-stage training pipeline establishes shared decision capabilities, specializes the two variants, and equips AutoThink with reasoning through reasoning supervision and reinforcement learning. We introduce Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Deliberative Decisions (RLCD$^2$), which uses a frozen model and proper scoring rules to reward improvements in decision probability quality and applies a soft penalty to overlong reasoning traces. RLCD$^2$ raises the share of reasoning traces that terminate within the generation limit by up to 48 percentage points and cuts average reasoning length by up to 65%, while largely preserving decision accuracy. On the public subset of Decision Index 0.3, the Instant models outperform the strongest evaluated comparable-scale open-weight decision models by 7.4-16.9 points, and the 27B AutoThink model reaches 73.4. We also introduce DecisionPivot, a programmatically verifiable benchmark of computational decisions built from contrast pairs that differ in a single answer-changing detail. On DecisionPivot, AutoThink outperforms its Instant counterparts by 11.5-18.4 points in pair accuracy and leads among evaluated systems. The models can be run using frameworks such as vLLM and MLX, with quantized versions available to reduce memory usage.Inference code and links to model weights are available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/Startlux-Decision .

analysis.key_results: 在Decision Index 0.3公开子集上，Instant模型比最强可比规模开放权重决策模型高出7.4-16.9分；27B AutoThink达到73.4分。RLCD²将推理跟踪在生成限制内终止的比例提高最多48个百分点，平均推理长度减少最多65%。在DecisionPivot上，AutoThink比Instant对应模型准确率高出11.5-18.4分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了StartLux-Decision决策模型，包括Instant（单遍）和AutoThink（自适应推理）变体，以及RLCD²强化学习方法，用于校准决策置信度并控制推理令牌长度，同时保持准确性。
analysis.method: 三阶段训练管线：共享能力训练、变体专业化、AutoThink推理监督与强化学习；RLCD²使用冻结模型和proper scoring rules优化决策概率质量并惩罚过长推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该工作提出了从0.8B到27B参数的决策模型系列，结合单遍高效预测与自适应推理，并引入RLCD²方法以校准推理长度并提高效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文主要关注决策模型中的高效推理与量化，未直接涉及机器人操作、视觉语言动作（VLA）或世界模型（WAM）。其量化版本和高效推理方法可能对资源受限的机器人部署具有潜在借鉴意义，但摘要未明确建立与机器人或体现智能的联系。

papers.abstract: Disease classification from patient-reported symptom descriptions is usually approached with lightweight discriminative models or with autoregressive large language models (LLMs), which understand language broadly but generate text token by token and require output parsing. We study decision foundation models, which score a closed set of candidate labels in a single forward pass without generating text. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, to the 24-class Symptom2Disease benchmark using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) on a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases. The fine-tuned model reaches 95.42% accuracy (95% CI 91.98-97.42%) and a macro F1 of 0.9551, up from 65.00% for the unadapted weights (62.92% through the remote API). However, TF-IDF linear SVM and logistic regression baselines trained on the same split reach 98.75% (95% CI 96.39-99.57%) with sub-millisecond CPU inference, so on this benchmark the fine-tuned model offers no accuracy advantage over a well-tuned linear classifier. A Leave-One-Symptom-Out clause-ablation analysis of four illustrative narratives shows predictions depending on distinguishing clauses: in a psoriasis example, removing the clause describing silvery scales lowers the predicted probability from above 99.99% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo, while removing other clauses changes it by less than 0.001 percentage points. Decision architectures deliver structured, single-pass predictions from large language backbones, but short, lexically distinctive benchmarks such as Symptom2Disease cannot show an advantage over simple baselines; validation on longer, real clinical text and clinician review are needed.

analysis.key_results: 微调模型准确率达95.42%，宏观F1为0.9551；TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线准确率达98.75%；消融分析显示预测强烈依赖于区分性症状描述。
analysis.limitations: 在短、词汇特征明显的基准数据集上，微调模型无法超越简单基线；需要在更长、真实的临床文本上验证并经临床医生审查。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明了在Symptom2Disease基准上，经过4-bit QLoRA微调的90亿参数决策模型虽然大幅提升了准确率，但与简单的TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线相比没有优势。
analysis.method: 使用QLoRA（4-bit量化的低秩适应）对基于Qwen3.5的Clef-Flash决策模型进行微调，并与TF-IDF线性SVM和逻辑回归基线进行比较，还进行了Leave-One-Symptom-Out消融分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究微调了一个90亿参数的决策基础模型用于症状到疾病分类，并将其与简单的TF-IDF线性基线进行对比，结果显示微调模型在准确率上并不占优。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究的是语言模型量化微调在文本分类任务上的效果，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）或WAM（世界-动作模型）没有直接关系，但量化方法可作为参考。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation in large language models. In each drafting stage, a lightweight draft model proposes tokens that the target model subsequently verifies. With increasingly capable draft models, we find that the target model frequently accepts all tokens produced in a drafting stage. A verification nevertheless follows each drafting stage, resulting in unnecessary target-model forward passes even when drafting could have continued. Adaptive draft length methods decide during decoding how many draft tokens precede a verification, but they raise the speedup only for autoregressive draft models. For a parallel draft model, drafting further requires target-model hidden states for draft tokens that have not been verified. We propose DLoop, a looped form of speculative decoding that adaptively performs multiple drafting stages before verification. DLoop continues drafting while the draft model remains confident and verifies all accumulated draft tokens together. Loop-aware training keeps the draft model reliable in the additional drafting stages by exposing it to its own hidden states for unverified draft tokens. By spending additional draft-model forward passes, DLoop reduces the number of target-model forward passes required for verification. Across diverse speculative decoding methods including EAGLE-3, DFlash, Domino, DSpark, and multi-token prediction modules, DLoop improves the wall-clock speedup by 5 to 41 percent while preserving lossless decoding. Code will be available at https://github.com/naver-ai/DLoop.

analysis.key_results: 在EAGLE-3、DFlash、Domino、DSpark及多令牌预测模块等多种投机解码方法上，DLoop将墙钟加速比提高了5%至41%，同时保持无损解码。
analysis.main_contribution: DLoop方法：循环投机解码，在验证前进行多轮起草，并利用循环感知训练保持草稿模型可靠性。
analysis.method: DLoop：在草稿模型自信时继续起草，累积多个草稿阶段的令牌，然后一次性验证；循环感知训练使草稿模型适应自身未验证令牌的隐藏状态。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出DLoop，一种循环形式的投机解码，在验证前自适应地执行多个起草阶段，以减少目标模型的前向传播次数并提升加速比。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用大语言模型的投机解码，未涉及视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）、世界-动作模型（WAM）或机器人领域，但与VLA/WAM的高效推理加速有潜在方法学借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: World-model agents are usually evaluated in simulators that can wait for the policy; live games impose the opposite constraint, requiring capture, prediction, and action before the next frame. We present DashVMC, which learns a compact, action-conditioned world model from approximately two hours of recorded Geometry Dash gameplay. To test whether the learned dynamics are actionable, a controller is initialized by behavioural cloning (BC) and refined with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) entirely in frozen-model rollouts, without further interaction with the live game. Across three controller seeds, the refined policies survive longer than their BC initializations on all three official levels and a held-out community layout. At deployment, the baseline skips visual generation and sustains a 60-Hz capture-to-action loop on a consumer GPU. Action-conditioned continuations and rollout diagnostics show that the model remains useful for control despite imperfect long-horizon fidelity.

analysis.key_results: 在三个种子中，PPO 精炼后的策略在所有三个官方关卡和一个社区关卡上存活时间均长于 BC 初始化；部署时可跳过视觉生成，在消费级 GPU 上维持 60Hz 的感知-控制循环。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 DashVMC 方法，通过紧凑的动作条件世界模型和冻结模型中的强化学习，在实时约束下实现游戏控制。
analysis.method: 从录屏数据学习动作条件世界模型，用行为克隆初始化控制器，再在冻结模型滚动中使用 PPO 进行优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DashVMC 从约两小时的游戏录屏中学习紧凑的动作条件世界模型，并在冻结模型滚动中训练策略，实现实时控制，无需与游戏环境交互。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作涉及世界模型和策略学习，但以游戏为场景，未涉及 VLA 或机器人操作。与本站主题无直接关系，但方法具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) enable unified audio-video understanding, but their long multimodal token sequences make deployment computationally expensive. Token compression reduces this cost, yet aggressive compression often lowers accuracy. Existing works predominantly focus on designing better compression mechanisms; however, adapting the underlying language model to reason effectively over the remaining compressed context remains under-explored. To address this, we propose CAFD (Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation), a ground-truth-free self-distillation framework that adapts OmniLLMs to fixed compression pipelines without requiring reference answers, rationales, or correctness rewards. CAFD leverages the full-token view of the same multimodal sample as a source of privileged information: a full-context self-teacher provides soft target supervision to a compressed-context student along the student's on-policy trajectory. Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B across five audio-video benchmarks, five compression pipelines, and five deployment budgets, CAFD demonstrates consistent gains, improving 120 out of 125 conditions with an average accuracy boost of 1.44 points and recovering 26.9% of the accuracy gap on average. These results demonstrate that the proposed ground-truth-free adaptation offers an effective and practical route to improving the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in deployed OmniLLMs.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上于5个音视频基准、5种压缩流程和5种部署预算下，120/125条件下获得提升，平均准确率提升1.44点，平均恢复26.9%的精度差距。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CAFD（Compressed-Context Adaptation via Full-Context Distillation），一种无真值自蒸馏方法，使全模态大语言模型适应固定压缩流程，无需参考答案或奖励。
analysis.method: 利用同一样本的全token视图作为特权信息，以全上下文自教师模型向压缩上下文学生模型沿在策略轨迹提供软目标监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CAFD框架，通过全上下文自蒸馏在无真值条件下让全模态大语言模型适应固定压缩流程，提升压缩后推理精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文关注全模态大语言模型压缩上下文的自蒸馏适应，属于高效推理方法，非VLA/WAM或机器人领域；其无真值蒸馏思路对VLA/WAM的上下文压缩适应有一定借鉴意义，但无直接结合。

papers.title: Learning to Reason with Compressed Context: Ground-Truth-Free Adaptation of OmniLLMs via Self-Distillation

papers.abstract: Humans typically rely on vision, touch, hearing, and proprioception to perceive contact and adapt their actions during manipulation. Providing robots with comparable responsiveness therefore requires hardware that can retain and use these complementary sensory signals. Most imitation-learning systems, however, observe demonstrations primarily through vision and proprioception, limiting access to contact information that is difficult to infer visually. We present PolyUMI, an open-source platform for scalable visual--tactile--audio demonstration collection and robot deployment. Its lightweight, wireless handheld gripper records synchronized wrist-camera, optical tactile, contact-audio, and proprioceptive observations without requiring a tethered workstation. The same sensing finger can be transferred to the robot end effector, preserving the sensing geometry between demonstration collection and policy execution. To effectively use these heterogeneous observations, we further introduce VisTA, a token-level multimodal policy that integrates information across sensors and time to predict contact-aware robot actions. Experiments spanning object inference, slip control, and contact-rich manipulation show that touch and audio reveal task-relevant information beyond vision and that VisTA is competitive with or outperforms existing multimodal policies. Together, PolyUMI and VisTA provide an accessible pipeline for collecting multimodal demonstrations and learning policies that perceive physical interaction beyond vision. Project Page: https://polyumi-vista.github.io

analysis.key_results: 在物体推理、滑动控制和接触丰富操作等实验中，触觉和音频揭示了视觉之外的任务相关信息，VisTA与现有多模态策略相比具有竞争力或更优性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出开源平台PolyUMI，支持可扩展的视觉-触觉-音频演示采集与机器人部署；同时提出VisTA，一种令牌级多模态策略，融合多传感器时间信息以预测接触感知动作。
analysis.method: PolyUMI使用轻量无线手持夹爪同步记录腕部相机、光触觉、接触音频和本体感觉数据，且同一传感手指可迁移至机器人末端以保持传感几何；VisTA采用令牌级多模态策略整合多传感器与时间信息。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 介绍PolyUMI开源平台和VisTA多模态策略，用于同步采集视觉-触觉-音频-本体感觉数据并学习接触感知的机器人操作策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向视觉-语言-动作（VLA）和机器人操作，提供多模态数据采集与策略学习方法，与本站主题高度相关。
